Su Self-Help Center ofrece orientación a personas que se representan a sí mismas en cortes civiles del Condado de Travis, incluyendo ayuda para investigar preguntas legales, formularios y referencias a sitios web y libros. Los bibliotecarios de derecho están disponibles en persona y también ofrecen servicios remotos.
description_en: The Travis County Law Library has helped county residents find legal information since 1983. Its Self-Help Center assists people representing themselves in Travis County civil courts, including help researching legal questions, providing forms, and pointing to websites and books. Law librarians are available in person and also offer remote services.
eligibility_es: Abierto al público, principalmente personas que se representan a sí mismas (sin abogado) en cortes civiles del Condado de Travis.
eligibility_en: Open to the public, primarily people representing themselves (without an attorney) in Travis County civil courts.
application_steps_es: Visite el Self-Help Center en 1700 Guadalupe St., 2.º piso, Austin, TX durante el horario de atención, llame al (512) 854-8677, o utilice los servicios remotos listados en el sitio web.
application_steps_en: Visit the Self-Help Center at 1700 Guadalupe St., 2nd Floor, Austin, TX during open hours, call (512) 854-8677, or use the remote services listed on the website.
hours_es: Lunes a viernes, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Cerrado sábados, domingos y días feriados oficiales.
hours_en: Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Closed Saturdays, Sundays, and official holidays.
verification_notes: Address, phone, and hours confirmed via the library's own contact-us page. Cost (free public service) was not explicitly restated on the pages fetched today but is standard/well-established for Texas county law library self-help centers and was described this way in a Texas Law Help directory listing found in search results — flagged as reasonably but not 100% freshly confirmed. Note this office shares the same street address (1700 Guadalupe St.) as the County Clerk Civil Division (idx 91) and Recording Division sub-station (idx 88) — all are in the Civil and Family Courts Facility building, but are distinct organizations/services, not duplicates. Email not found/confirmed, left blank.

title_es: Servicios de jurado y pasaportes
summary_es: La Oficina del Secretario del Tribunal de Distrito del Condado de Travis administra la respuesta a citaciones de jurado y ofrece servicios de solicitud y renovación de pasaporte para el público.
summary_en: The Travis County District Clerk's Office manages jury summons response and offers passport application and renewal services to the public.
description_es: Esta oficina coordina el servicio de jurado del Condado de Travis: las personas citadas pueden responder en línea a través del sistema I-Jury o en persona, reportar conflictos de horario y recibir recordatorios antes de presentarse a la corte. La misma oficina también actúa como agencia aceptadora de pasaportes de EE.UU., donde se puede completar el formulario DS-11, presentar evidencia de ciudadanía e identificación, tomarse la foto y pagar las tarifas estatales y del condado.
description_en: This office coordinates Travis County jury service: those summoned can respond online through the I-Jury system or in person, report schedule conflicts, and receive reminders before appearing in court. The same office also serves as a U.S. passport acceptance facility, where applicants can complete Form DS-11, present citizenship evidence and ID, get a passport photo, and pay state and county fees.
eligibility_es: El servicio de jurado aplica a personas registradas para votar o con licencia de conducir/identificación de Texas en el Condado de Travis que reciben una citación. Los servicios de pasaporte están abiertos al público en general con cita o como caminantes según disponibilidad.
eligibility_en: Jury service applies to Travis County residents with a Texas driver's license/ID or voter registration who receive a summons. Passport services are open to the general public by appointment or walk-in as available.
required_documents_es: Para jurado: formulario de citación. Para pasaporte: formulario DS-11, evidencia original/certificada de ciudadanía estadounidense y copias, identificación con foto vigente, y fotografía tipo pasaporte.
required_documents_en: For jury: the summons form. For passport: Form DS-11, original/certified evidence of U.S. citizenship plus photocopies, valid photo ID, and a passport photo.
application_steps_es: Jurado: responder en línea en ijury.traviscountytx.gov o en persona en la oficina, indicando conflictos de horario. Pasaporte: sacar cita en línea (nuevas citas se publican los lunes a las 8:00 a.m.) o acudir como caminante, llevar los documentos requeridos y pagar las tarifas.
application_steps_en: Jury: respond online at ijury.traviscountytx.gov or in person at the office, noting any schedule conflicts. Passport: book an appointment online (new appointments post Mondays at 8:00 a.m.) or go as a walk-in, bring required documents, and pay the fees.
hours_es: Oficina general: lunes a viernes, 8:00 a.m. – 4:30 p.m. Oficina de pasaportes (5325 Airport Blvd): 8:00 a.m. – 3:30 p.m.
hours_en: General office: Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m. – 4:30 p.m. Passport office (5325 Airport Blvd): 8:00 a.m. – 3:30 p.m.
verification_notes: Confirmed today via official traviscountytx.gov pages (jury-duty and passport). This record combines two distinct services under one District Clerk office: jury duty (phone 512-854-9669, email ijury@traviscountytx.gov) and passports (phone 512-854-4295, no dedicated email found, general districtclerkhelp@traviscountytx.gov). Passport walk-in office is at 5325 Airport Blvd, 1st Floor; jury office is at the same building, Suite 1100. Additional appointment-only passport locations exist at 1700 Guadalupe 3rd Floor and 8110 N FM 620 Rd. Passport fees: $130-$160 state fee (adult) plus $35 county execution fee and optional $14 photo fee; jury response itself has no direct cost to the juror. Languages offered were not explicitly confirmed on official pages. Recommend admin review to decide if this should be split into two separate resource entries (jury vs. passports) given they are functionally distinct services.

title_es: Presentación y procesamiento de divorcios
summary_es: La Oficina del Secretario del Tribunal de Distrito del Condado de Travis recibe y procesa las solicitudes de divorcio presentadas ante los tribunales de familia del condado.
summary_en: The Travis County District Clerk's Office receives and processes divorce petitions filed with the county's family courts.
description_es: El Secretario del Tribunal de Distrito registra la Petición Original de Divorcio, le asigna un número de causa y la designa a un tribunal. El personal no puede dar asesoría legal ni completar los documentos por el solicitante; quienes se representan a sí mismos pueden buscar ayuda en Texas Law Help o en la Biblioteca de Derecho del Condado de Travis. Las solicitudes pueden presentarse en persona o electrónicamente mediante eFileTexas.
description_en: The District Clerk files the Original Petition for Divorce, assigns it a cause number, and designates a court. Staff cannot provide legal advice or complete paperwork for filers; self-represented individuals can seek help from Texas Law Help or the Travis County Law Library. Filings can be submitted in person or electronically through eFileTexas.
eligibility_es: Según fuentes de terceros (no confirmado en la página oficial), se requiere que al menos uno de los cónyuges haya residido en Texas por 6 meses y en el Condado de Travis por 90 días antes de presentar la demanda.
eligibility_en: Per third-party sources (not confirmed on the official page), at least one spouse must have resided in Texas for 6 months and in Travis County for 90 days before filing.
required_documents_es: Petición Original de Divorcio (documentos de una sola cara), formulario de Estadísticas Vitales VS-165 con la orden final, y formulario de Registro de Orden de Manutención 1828A si aplica manutención infantil.
required_documents_en: Original Petition for Divorce (single-sided documents), Vital Statistics Form VS-165 with the final order, and Record of Support Order Form 1828A if child support applies.
application_steps_es: Presentar la Petición Original de Divorcio en persona en la Instalación de Cortes Civiles y de Familia o electrónicamente vía eFileTexas; pagar las tarifas de presentación; la petición debe permanecer archivada al menos 60 días antes de la audiencia final.
application_steps_en: File the Original Petition for Divorce in person at the Civil & Family Courts Facility or electronically via eFileTexas; pay filing fees; the petition must be on file at least 60 days before the final hearing.
hours_es: Lunes a viernes, 8:00 a.m. – 4:30 p.m.
hours_en: Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m. – 4:30 p.m.
verification_notes: Confirmed office location, hours, phone, email and filing process today via traviscountytx.gov. The official page does not state the exact filing fee or residency requirements; the $350 filing fee and 6-month/90-day residency requirement came from third-party legal sites (modernfamilylaw.com, divorcecanbesimple.com), not the county's own page, so treat those two figures as unconfirmed pending official verification. Court hearing scheduling has a separate line: 512-854-2484.

title_es: Cobro y cumplimiento de manutención familiar
summary_es: La Oficina de Relaciones Domésticas del Condado de Travis administra el cobro y cumplimiento de la manutención infantil y de cónyuge ordenada por los tribunales del condado.
summary_en: The Travis County Domestic Relations Office manages the collection and enforcement of child and spousal support ordered by county courts.
description_es: Bajo contrato con la Oficina del Fiscal General de Texas (OAG), esta oficina cobra y distribuye pagos de manutención infantil y médica, hace cumplir órdenes de manutención y de visitación para casos del Condado de Travis, y puede designar tutores ad litem en casos que involucran a menores. También ofrece servicios de registro para el expediente de Servicios de Protección Infantil (CPS).
description_en: Under contract with the Texas Office of the Attorney General (OAG), this office collects and disburses child and medical support payments, enforces child and medical support and visitation orders for Travis County cases, and can appoint guardians ad litem in cases involving children. It also provides docketing services for the CPS docket.
eligibility_es: Aplica a casos de manutención infantil o médica ordenados por un tribunal del Condado de Travis.
eligibility_en: Applies to child or medical support cases ordered by a Travis County court.
required_documents_es: Formulario de Registro de Orden de Manutención (Record of Support).
required_documents_en: Record of Support form.
application_steps_es: Enviar el formulario de Registro de Manutención por correo, correo electrónico o en persona en la oficina.
application_steps_en: Submit the Record of Support form by mail, email, or in person at the office.
hours_es: Lunes a viernes, 8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. Sistema telefónico automatizado disponible las 24 horas.
hours_en: Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. 24-hour automated phone system available.
verification_notes: Confirmed address, phone, hours, and services today via traviscountytx.gov/dro. No fee schedule, eligibility income limits, or language access information was stated on the page, so cost_type and languages are left as unknown/empty rather than assumed. Email was reconstructed from an obfuscated Cloudflare mail-protection link (dro@traviscountytx.gov) — reasonably confident given the standard county email pattern but not independently verified elsewhere; recommend a spot-check before publishing.

organization_name: State of Texas – Texas Department of Public Safety
title_es: Departamento de Seguridad Pública de Texas (TxDPS)
summary_es: Agencia estatal que ofrece servicios relacionados con licencias de conducir, tarjetas de identificación de Texas, registros de conducir, elegibilidad de licencias, antecedentes criminales y otros servicios de seguridad pública.
summary_en: State agency providing driver license and Texas ID services, driver records, license eligibility services, criminal history records, and other public safety services.
description_es: Información y servicios públicos ofrecidos por TX DPS (Dept. of Public Safety).
description_en: Public information and services provided by TX DPS (Dept. of Public Safety).
eligibility_es: Residentes de Texas y otras personas que cumplan con los requisitos para el servicio específico. Los requisitos de elegibilidad y documentación varían según el servicio.
eligibility_en: Texas residents and other individuals who meet the requirements for the specific service. Eligibility and documentation requirements vary by service.
application_steps_es: Contacte a la oficina o consulte su sitio web para confirmar requisitos y proceso.
application_steps_en: Contact the office or check its website to confirm requirements and process.
hours_es: El Departamento de Seguridad Pública de Texas (TxDPS) es una agencia estatal que administra diversos servicios públicos relacionados con la identificación y la conducción. Las familias pueden utilizar TxDPS para solicitar, renovar o reemplazar licencias de conducir y tarjetas de identificación de Texas, actualizar información, consultar la elegibilidad de una licencia y solicitar registros de conducir. También ofrece acceso a determinados registros criminales, servicios de huellas digitales y otros servicios relacionados con la seguridad pública. Muchos trámites pueden realizarse en línea; los servicios de licencia o identificación que requieren atención presencial deben realizarse mediante cita en una oficina de Driver License designada.
hours_en: The Texas Department of Public Safety (TxDPS) is a state agency that administers public services related to identification and driving. Families can use TxDPS to apply for, renew, or replace Texas driver licenses and identification cards, update personal information, check driver license eligibility, and request driver records. TxDPS also provides access to certain criminal history records, fingerprinting services, and other public safety-related services. Many transactions can be completed online; services requiring an in-person visit must be completed by appointment at a designated Driver License office.
service_area_en: A nivel estatal – Todos los condados de Texas
verification_notes:
Varies by service. Some services are free; driver license/ID transactions and records may have fees.

Important: 5805 N. Lamar Blvd. is the TxDPS Austin Headquarters, not a standard neighborhood Driver License office. For DL/ID transactions, users should check whether their service can be completed online and, if an in-person visit is required, schedule an appointment at a designated Driver License office.
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX.

title_es: Secretario del Condado de Williamson
summary_es: Oficina del gobierno del Condado de Williamson que administra registros vitales, licencias de matrimonio, registros públicos, documentos de propiedad, nombres comerciales (DBA), ciertos tribunales del condado y servicios de probate.
summary_en: Williamson County government office responsible for vital records, marriage licenses, public records, property documents, assumed names (DBAs), certain county courts, and probate services.
description_es: La Oficina del Secretario del Condado de Williamson proporciona una variedad de servicios gubernamentales y de registros para residentes del condado. Las familias pueden acudir a esta oficina para obtener actas de nacimiento y defunción, solicitar una licencia de matrimonio y copias certificadas de registros, registrar determinados documentos de propiedad, presentar nombres comerciales (DBA) y acceder a otros registros públicos. La oficina también presta servicios a ciertos tribunales del condado y al Probate Court. Es importante confirmar la ubicación antes de acudir, ya que los servicios de tribunales se encuentran en el Justice Center, mientras que los servicios de registros vitales, matrimonio y registros de propiedad se ofrecen en 1848 Texas Trail.
description_en: The Williamson County Clerk’s Office provides a variety of government and records services for county residents. Families can use the office to obtain birth and death records, apply for a marriage license and certified copies of records, record certain property documents, file assumed names (DBAs), and access other public records. The office also provides services for certain county courts and the Probate Court. Visitors should confirm the correct location before going in person because court services are located at the Justice Center, while vital records, marriage, and land-recording services are provided at 1848 Texas Trail.
eligibility_es: Residentes y otras personas que cumplan con los requisitos del servicio solicitado. Los requisitos de acceso a registros y documentos varían según el tipo de registro y servicio.
eligibility_en: Residents and other individuals who meet the requirements for the requested service. Requirements for accessing records and documents vary depending on the type of record and service.
application_steps_es: Contacte a la oficina o consulte su sitio web para confirmar requisitos y proceso.
application_steps_en: Contact the office or check its website to confirm requirements and process.
hours_es:
Registros, registros y estadísticas vitales: lunes–viernes, de 8:00 a. m. - 4:30 p. m. 
Sala de Tribunales: lunes–viernes, de 8:00am - 5:00 pm. Cerrado en días festivos.
hours_en:
Records, Recording & Vital Statistics: Monday – Friday (8:00 AM – 4:30 PM. 
Courts Division: Monday – Friday (8:00 AM–5:00 PM)
Closed on public holidays.
verification_notes:
Actas de nacimiento; actas de defunción; licencias de matrimonio; copias certificadas de registros; registros públicos; registros de propiedad; DBAs/Assumed Names; liens; plats; probate; County Courts; documentos judiciales; occupational licenses.

Cost: Varies by service. Fees apply to many records, licenses, filings, and court services.

Importante: Hay diferentes ubicaciones según el servicio. Court services: 405 MLK. Marriage/Birth/Death, Land Recording y Assumed Names: 1848 Texas Trail. La oficina indica que no puede realizar búsquedas de registros por solicitud general debido a una opinión del Attorney General y que no ofrece asesoría legal.
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX.

title_es: Actas vitales, escrituras y registros judiciales
title_en: Vital records, deeds, and court filings
summary_es: La Oficina del Secretario del Condado de Bastrop gestiona registros públicos como actas de nacimiento, matrimonio y defunción, escrituras de propiedad y documentos de tribunales de sucesiones y del condado.
summary_en: The Bastrop County Clerk's Office manages public records such as birth, marriage, and death certificates, property deeds, and probate/county court documents.
description_es: Esta oficina administra el registro de tierras, actas de nacimiento, matrimonio y defunción, presentaciones de negocios, marcas de ganado, gravámenes, y funciones administrativas de las cortes de sucesiones y del condado. Ofrece licencias de matrimonio y acceso a registros públicos, con algunos servicios disponibles a través de un portal de consulta en línea.
description_en: This office administers land recording, birth/marriage/death certificates, business filings, cattle brands, liens, and administrative functions for probate court and county court at law. It issues marriage licenses and provides access to public records, with some services available through an online lookup portal.
eligibility_es: Abierto al público general del Condado de Bastrop que necesite registrar o solicitar documentos públicos.
eligibility_en: Open to the general public in Bastrop County needing to record or request public documents.
required_documents_es: Varía según el trámite (por ejemplo, identificación con foto para licencias de matrimonio).
required_documents_en: Varies by transaction (e.g., photo ID for marriage licenses).
application_steps_es: Acudir en persona durante horario de oficina o usar el portal de registros en línea del condado, según el trámite.
application_steps_en: Visit in person during office hours or use the county's online records portal, depending on the transaction.
hours_es: Lunes a jueves 8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.; viernes 8:00 a.m. – 4:00 p.m. Licencias de matrimonio: lunes a jueves 8:30 a.m. – 4:00 p.m.; viernes 8:30 a.m. – 3:00 p.m.
hours_en: Monday–Thursday 8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.; Friday 8:00 a.m. – 4:00 p.m. Marriage licenses: Monday–Thursday 8:30 a.m. – 4:00 p.m.; Friday 8:30 a.m. – 3:00 p.m.
verification_notes: Confirmed today via the official bastropcounty.gov page (address 803 Pine Street, phone 512-332-7234). Note: some third-party directories (e.g., NETR Online) list a different address (804 Pecan Street) and phone (512-332-7236) — likely outdated or a related annex; the official .gov page was treated as authoritative. No email address was found on the official page. No fee schedule details were extracted (available as separate PDFs on the site) and no language-access information was found.

title_es: Administración del Seguro Social – Oficina de Austin
title_en: Social Security Administration (SSA) – Austin Field Office
summary_es: Agencia federal que administra beneficios de jubilación, discapacidad, Seguro Social para sobrevivientes, SSI y Medicare, además de servicios relacionados con las tarjetas y números de Seguro Social.
summary_en: Federal agency that administers Social Security retirement, disability, survivor, SSI, and Medicare-related programs, as well as Social Security number and card services.
description_es: La Administración del Seguro Social (SSA) es una agencia federal que administra programas de beneficios para jubilación, discapacidad, sobrevivientes y Seguridad de Ingreso Suplementario (SSI). También ofrece servicios relacionados con tarjetas y números de Seguro Social, Medicare, comprobantes de beneficios, estado de solicitudes, cambios de información y apelaciones. Muchas gestiones pueden realizarse en línea a través de una cuenta my Social Security. Cuando se requiere atención presencial, la SSA recomienda hacer una cita antes de acudir a una oficina.
description_en: The Social Security Administration (SSA) is a federal agency that administers retirement, disability, survivor, and Supplemental Security Income (SSI) benefits. It also provides services related to Social Security cards and numbers, Medicare, benefit verification, application status, information updates, and appeals. Many services can be completed online through a my Social Security account. When in-person assistance is needed, SSA recommends making an appointment before visiting a local office.
keywords_es: estado de cuenta del Seguro Social
eligibility_es: Ciudadanos estadounidenses y personas no ciudadanas que cumplan con los requisitos del servicio específico de Seguro Social, SSI, Medicare o servicios relacionados con la tarjeta. Los requisitos varían según el programa y las circunstancias de cada persona.
eligibility_en: U.S. citizens and eligible noncitizens who meet the requirements for the specific Social Security, SSI, Medicare, or card-related service. Eligibility varies by program and individual circumstances.
application_steps_es: Contacte a la oficina o consulte su sitio web para confirmar requisitos y proceso.
application_steps_en: Contact the office or check its website to confirm requirements and process.
hours_es: Lunes–viernes, 9:00 AM–4:00 PM. Cerrado fines de semana y días festivos federales. Se recomienda hacer una cita y muchos servicios presenciales requieren cita.
hours_en: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–4:00 PM. Closed weekends and federal holidays. Appointments are recommended/required for many in-person services.
accessibility_notes_es: En línea a través de SSA.gov y my Social Security, por teléfono, por correo o en persona cuando sea necesario. Se recomienda hacer una cita antes de visitar la oficina. Muchos trámites pueden completarse en línea sin acudir personalmente.
accessibility_notes_en: Online through SSA.gov and my Social Security, by phone, by mail, or in person at a local field office when needed. Make an appointment before visiting. Many services can be completed online without visiting an office.
service_area_es: El área de servicio incluye partes de los condados de Bastrop, Hays, Travis y Williamson.
service_area_en: Austin Field Office service area includes parts of Bastrop, Hays, Travis, and Williamson Counties.
verification_notes:
Costo: Social Security services and benefit applications are generally free. Some replacement documents or related services may have specific rules or fees; verify with SSA before applying.

Important: Do not list this as a general walk-in resource. SSA recommends making an appointment before visiting. Many services can be completed online. Use the official SSA Office Locator with the family's ZIP code because SSA has more than one Austin field office and the appropriate office can depend on the person's address. The national phone line offers Spanish assistance by pressing 7.
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX.

organization_name: United States Bankruptcy Court – Western District of Texas
title_es: Tribunal de Bancarrota de los Estados Unidos – División de Austin
title_en: U.S. Bankruptcy Court – Western District of Texas, Austin Division
summary_es: Tribunal federal que administra casos de bancarrota para personas y empresas en la División de Austin del Distrito Oeste de Texas, incluyendo los condados de Travis y Williamson.
summary_en: Federal court that administers bankruptcy cases for individuals and businesses in the Austin Division of the Western District of Texas, including Travis and Williamson Counties.
description_es: El Tribunal de Bancarrota de los Estados Unidos para el Distrito Oeste de Texas administra los casos de bancarrota de la División de Austin. Las personas que enfrentan problemas financieros pueden encontrar en este sitio información sobre los diferentes capítulos de bancarrota, requisitos para presentar un caso, formularios, tarifas, procedimientos para presentar un caso sin abogado y acceso a información de casos. El tribunal también proporciona información sobre asesoría crediticia obligatoria antes de presentar una bancarrota y cursos de administración financiera requeridos después de la presentación. El personal del tribunal no puede brindar asesoría legal ni ayudar a preparar los formularios.
description_en: The U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Western District of Texas administers bankruptcy cases in the Austin Division. Individuals experiencing financial difficulties can find information about the different bankruptcy chapters, filing requirements, forms, fees, procedures for filing without an attorney, and access to case information. The court also provides information about required credit counseling before filing and financial management courses required after filing. Court staff cannot provide legal advice or assist with preparing bankruptcy forms.
eligibility_es: Personas y empresas que cumplen con los requisitos para presentar un caso de bancarrota dentro del Distrito Oeste de Texas/División de Austin. La elegibilidad y el capítulo de bancarrota apropiado dependen de las circunstancias de cada persona o empresa. El tribunal proporciona información, pero no determina qué capítulo debe presentar una persona.
eligibility_en: Individuals and businesses that meet the requirements to file a bankruptcy case within the Western District of Texas/Austin Division. Eligibility and the appropriate bankruptcy chapter depend on the individual's or business's circumstances. The court provides information but does not determine which chapter a person should file.
application_steps_es: Contacte a la oficina o consulte su sitio web para confirmar requisitos y proceso.
application_steps_en: Contact the office or check its website to confirm requirements and process.
hours_es: Lunes–viernes, 8:00 AM–12:00 PM y 1:00 PM–4:00 PM CST. Cerrado diariamente de 12:00–1:00 PM.
hours_en: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–12:00 PM and 1:00 PM–4:00 PM CST. Closed daily from 12:00–1:00 PM.
service_area_es: División de Austin — condados de Bastrop, Blanco, Burleson, Burnet, Caldwell, Gillespie, Hays, Kimble, Lampasas, Lee, Llano, Mason, McCulloch, San Saba, Travis, Washington y Williamson.
service_area_en: Austin Division — Bastrop, Blanco, Burleson, Burnet, Caldwell, Gillespie, Hays, Kimble, Lampasas, Lee, Llano, Mason, McCulloch, San Saba, Travis, Washington, and Williamson Counties.
verification_notes:
Cost: Filing fees vary by bankruptcy chapter. Current court fee schedule lists $338 for Chapter 7 and $313 for Chapter 13; other chapters have different fees. Eligible Chapter 7 debtors may request a filing-fee waiver, and individuals who cannot pay the full fee may request installment payments. Attorney fees are separate and are not included in court filing fees.

Important: This is a court, not a legal aid organization. The Clerk's Office cannot provide legal advice or help individuals prepare their bankruptcy forms. The court recommends reviewing its information for people filing without an attorney. Individual debtors generally must complete approved credit counseling before filing and a financial management course after filing to receive a discharge.
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX.

organization_name: U.S. Department of Homeland Security – U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services
title_es: Servicios de Ciudadanía e Inmigración de Estados Unidos (USCIS)
summary_es: Agencia federal responsable de administrar y adjudicar solicitudes de beneficios de inmigración y ciudadanía dentro de Estados Unidos.
summary_en: Federal agency responsible for administering and adjudicating immigration and citizenship benefit applications in the United States.
description_es: USCIS es la agencia federal encargada de procesar y decidir una amplia variedad de beneficios migratorios y de ciudadanía dentro de Estados Unidos. Las personas pueden utilizar USCIS para solicitar la ciudadanía estadounidense, residencia permanente (Green Card), permisos de trabajo, peticiones familiares, ajuste de estatus y otros beneficios migratorios. USCIS también administra procesos relacionados con TPS, asilo afirmativo, parole humanitario, certificados de ciudadanía y otros programas humanitarios. Las personas pueden crear una cuenta de myUSCIS para administrar ciertos trámites, consultar el estado de un caso, recibir notificaciones y acceder a recursos oficiales.
description_en: USCIS is the federal agency responsible for processing and deciding a wide range of immigration and citizenship benefits in the United States. Individuals can use USCIS to apply for U.S. citizenship, permanent residence (Green Cards), employment authorization, family petitions, adjustment of status, and other immigration benefits. USCIS also administers programs and processes related to TPS, affirmative asylum, humanitarian parole, certificates of citizenship, and other humanitarian benefits. Individuals can create a myUSCIS account to manage certain applications, check case status, receive notifications, and access official resources.
eligibility_es: La elegibilidad depende del beneficio migratorio o de ciudadanía específico. Ciudadanos estadounidenses, residentes permanentes, personas no ciudadanas, solicitantes, empleadores y otras personas u organizaciones elegibles pueden utilizar los servicios de USCIS según la solicitud o petición correspondiente.
eligibility_en: Eligibility depends on the specific immigration or citizenship benefit. U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, noncitizens, petitioners, employers, and other eligible individuals or organizations may use USCIS services depending on the application or petition. USCIS does not determine eligibility for every immigration pathway simply through general inquiries.
application_steps_es: Contacte a la oficina o consulte su sitio web para confirmar requisitos y proceso.
application_steps_en: Contact the office or check its website to confirm requirements and process.
hours_es: Los servicios en línea están disponibles 24/7. El horario de las oficinas presenciales varía según la ubicación y el tipo de cita. USCIS recomienda verificar la oficina específica antes de acudir.
hours_en: Online services are available 24/7. Field office and other in-person hours vary by location and appointment type. USCIS advises checking the specific office before visiting.
verification_notes:
Address: No single local address. USCIS has field offices, Application Support Centers, service centers and other facilities. Use the official USCIS Office Locator to identify the appropriate location based on the service and ZIP code.

Cost: Fees vary significantly by form and immigration benefit. Some services are free, while many applications and petitions have filing fees. Certain applicants may qualify for a fee waiver for eligible forms. Always check the current USCIS fee schedule before filing.

mportant: USCIS is a government agency, not an immigration legal services provider. USCIS can provide information about its forms and processes but does not provide individualized legal advice or tell someone which immigration benefit they should apply for. If a family does not know what immigration option may apply to them, USCIS itself recommends seeking immigration legal advice from an authorized provider.
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX. [location-review: variable]

title_es: Orientación y reclamos de beneficios para veteranos
title_en: Veterans benefits counseling and claims assistance
summary_es: Oficina del Condado de Travis que ayuda a veteranos residentes o empleados del condado a solicitar beneficios y reclamos de discapacidad de la VA, sin costo alguno.
summary_en: A Travis County office that helps veteran residents or county employees apply for VA benefits and disability claims, at no cost.
description_es: Los Servicios para Veteranos del Condado de Travis ayudan con reclamos de discapacidad y beneficios de la VA, apelaciones, y remisiones a servicios médicos, de salud mental, vivienda, educación y asistencia financiera. Cuenta con coordinadores especializados para mujeres veteranas y temas LGBTQ+, además de servicios notariales. La atención es solo con cita previa, presencial o virtual.
description_en: Travis County Veterans Services helps with VA disability claims and benefits, appeals, and referrals to medical, mental health, housing, education, and financial assistance services. It has specialized coordinators for women veterans and LGBTQ+ issues, plus notary services. Services are by appointment only, in person or virtual.
eligibility_es: Veteranos y sus dependientes elegibles que sean residentes o empleados del Condado de Travis.
eligibility_en: Veterans and their eligible dependents who are Travis County residents or employees.
application_steps_es: Completar el formulario de contacto en línea o llamar para programar una cita presencial o virtual (solo con cita previa).
application_steps_en: Complete the online contact form or call to schedule an in-person or virtual appointment (by appointment only).
hours_es: Lunes a jueves, 9:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.; citas virtuales extendidas para empleados del condado, lunes a jueves, 5:00–9:00 p.m.
hours_en: Monday–Thursday, 9 am–4 pm; extended virtual appointments for county employees, Monday–Thursday, 5–9 pm.
verification_notes: El servicio principal es preparar y tramitar reclamos de beneficios de VA; las menciones de salud, vivienda, educación y otros servicios son remisiones, no categorías primarias.

organization_name: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA Central Texas)
title_es: Atención para Veteranos sin Hogar de VA Central Texas
title_en: VA Central Texas Homeless Veteran Care
summary_es: Programa del Sistema de Salud de VA Central Texas que ayuda a veteranos sin hogar o en riesgo de perderla a acceder a alimentos, vivienda temporal o permanente, tratamiento de adicciones y salud mental, y capacitación laboral.
summary_en: A Central Texas VA Health Care System program that helps homeless or at-risk veterans access food, transitional or permanent housing, addiction and mental health treatment, and job training.
description_es: El programa de atención para veteranos sin hogar de VA Central Texas ofrece alimento y vivienda inmediatos (transicional y permanente), capacitación laboral, desarrollo de habilidades para la vida, apoyo educativo, navegación del sistema de justicia y reinserción comunitaria, asistencia financiera para prevenir la falta de vivienda, y tratamiento de adicciones y depresión. Incluye el programa HUD-VASH, que combina vales de vivienda de HUD con manejo de casos clínicos de la VA.
description_en: The VA Central Texas homeless veteran care program provides immediate food and shelter (transitional and permanent), job training, life skills development, education support, justice-system navigation and community reentry, financial assistance to prevent homelessness, and addiction/depression treatment. It includes the HUD-VASH program, which combines HUD housing vouchers with VA clinical case management.
eligibility_es: Veteranos que están sin hogar o en riesgo de estarlo debido a dificultades financieras, desempleo, adicción, depresión o transición desde la cárcel.
eligibility_en: Veterans who are homeless or at risk of becoming homeless due to financial hardship, unemployment, addiction, depression, or transition from incarceration.
application_steps_es: Comunicarse con uno de los coordinadores de atención del programa (Atención Médica para Veteranos sin Hogar, o Vivienda de Apoyo HUD/VA) o llamar a la línea principal del Sistema de Salud de VA Central Texas.
application_steps_en: Contact one of the program's care coordinators (Health Care for Homeless Veterans, or HUD/VA Supportive Housing) or call the main Central Texas VA Health Care System line.
hours_es: Línea nacional disponible 24/7 (teléfono y chat en línea)
hours_en: National hotline available 24/7 (phone and online chat).
verification_notes:
Confirmed today via the official va.gov Central Texas homeless veteran care page. The page lists individual staff coordinator emails (e.g., paula.wood2@va.gov) rather than a general public phone/email for this specific program; used the main Central Texas VA Health Care System switchboard number as the best available phone contact — admin should verify whether a dedicated homeless-program line exists. No single public walk-in address was confirmed for this program (services are coordinated across facilities), so address fields left blank. Marked as emergency given the explicit focus on immediate food/shelter for homeless veterans, though this is a case-managed program rather than a 24/7 crisis line (that would be the Veterans Crisis Line, 988 then press 1).
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX.

title_es: Programa de Alcance de Justicia para Veteranos – Central Texas
title_en: VA Veterans Justice Outreach – Central Texas
summary_es: Programa de la VA que conecta a veteranos involucrados en el sistema de justicia penal, como en la cárcel o en tribunales, con servicios de salud mental, tratamiento de adicciones y apoyo para prevenir la falta de vivienda.
summary_en: A VA program that connects veterans involved in the criminal justice system, such as those incarcerated or in court, with mental health services, addiction treatment, and homelessness-prevention support.
description_es: El programa de Alcance de Justicia para Veteranos (VJO) del Sistema de Salud de VA Central Texas ayuda a veteranos que están en la cárcel, en libertad condicional o en tribunales de veteranos a conectarse con tratamiento de salud mental, adicciones y servicios de reinserción comunitaria, evitando así el encarcelamiento innecesario. El equipo atiende el área de Temple, Waco, Killeen, Georgetown, Bryan/College Station, Brownwood, La Grange, San Marcos y Austin.
description_en: The Central Texas VA Health Care System's Veterans Justice Outreach (VJO) program helps veterans who are incarcerated, on probation/parole, or in veterans treatment court connect with mental health, addiction, and community reentry services, aiming to avoid unnecessary incarceration. The team covers the Temple, Waco, Killeen, Georgetown, Bryan/College Station, Brownwood, La Grange, San Marcos, and Austin area.
eligibility_es: Veteranos involucrados en el sistema de justicia penal (por ejemplo, en la cárcel, en libertad condicional, o en un tribunal de veteranos) en el área de cobertura del Sistema de Salud de VA Central Texas.
eligibility_en: Veterans involved in the criminal justice system (e.g., incarcerated, on probation/parole, or in veterans treatment court) within the Central Texas VA Health Care System's coverage area.
application_steps_es: Comunicarse por correo electrónico al equipo de VJO; usualmente el contacto inicial ocurre a través de un enlace en la cárcel, el tribunal o un proveedor de VA.
application_steps_en: Contact the VJO team by email; initial contact usually happens through a liaison at the jail, court, or a VA provider.
hours_es: Comuníquese con el equipo VJO de Central Texas para conocer la disponibilidad. La línea nacional para veteranos sin vivienda está disponible 24/7.
hours_en: Contact the Central Texas VJO team for current availability. The National Call Center for Homeless Veterans is available 24/7.
service_area_es: Centro de Texas - Condados de Travis, Williamson, Hays, Caldwell y Bastrop
service_area_en: Central Texas - Travis, Williamson, Hays, Caldwell y Bastrop Counties
verification_notes:
Confirmed today via the official department.va.gov VJO contacts page, which lists a shared team email (CTXSWSVJO@va.gov) for the Temple/Waco/Killeen/Georgetown/Bryan-College Station/Brownwood/La Grange/San Marcos/Austin area. A VA Central Texas site-specific VJO page (centraltexas.va.gov) returned a 404 today. No direct phone number or single public walk-in address was found for this specific program — access is typically via referral from jail, court, or a VA provider rather than a public office visit, so address fields were left blank and phone left blank rather than substituting the general VA hospital switchboard.
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX.

title_es: Orientación y reclamos de beneficios para veteranos
title_en: Veterans benefits counseling and claims assistance
summary_es: Oficina del Condado de Williamson que ayuda a veteranos y sus familias a obtener beneficios federales, estatales y del condado, incluyendo asistencia financiera única para casos elegibles.
summary_en: A Williamson County office that helps veterans and their families obtain federal, state, and county benefits, including one-time financial assistance for eligible cases.
description_es: La Oficina de Servicios para Veteranos del Condado de Williamson ayuda a obtener beneficios de la VA, el estado de Texas y el condado, y administra fondos de asistencia financiera de emergencia única para veteranos elegibles, cónyuges actuales, cónyuges sobrevivientes e hijos dependientes. Cuenta con oficiales acreditados en anexos de Round Rock y Taylor, además de la oficina principal en Georgetown.
description_en: The Williamson County Veteran Services office helps obtain VA, State of Texas, and county benefits, and administers one-time emergency financial assistance funds for eligible veterans, current spouses, surviving spouses, and dependent children. It has accredited officers at Round Rock and Taylor annexes in addition to the main Georgetown office.
eligibility_es: Debe ser residente del Condado de Williamson; la elegibilidad específica de cada beneficio varía (incluye veteranos, cónyuges actuales, cónyuges sobrevivientes e hijos dependientes).
eligibility_en: Must be a Williamson County resident; specific eligibility varies by benefit type (includes veterans, current spouses, surviving spouses, and dependent children).
application_steps_es: Programar una cita por teléfono; la solicitud de asistencia financiera de emergencia está disponible en línea.
application_steps_en: Schedule an appointment by phone; the emergency financial assistance application is available online.
hours_es: Lunes a viernes, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m., con cita previa.
hours_en: Monday–Friday, 8 am–5 pm, by appointment only.
verification_notes:
Confirmed today via the official wilcotx.gov page (address, phone, hours, director name, services). Additional annexes in Round Rock and Taylor were mentioned but not individually verified/listed. The office email shown by the fetch tool was an obfuscated placeholder, not a real confirmed address, so it was left blank.
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX

organization_name: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) – VA Central Texas Healthcare System
title_es: VA Central Texas – Atención Médica para Veteranos
title_en: VA Central Texas – Veterans Health Care
summary_es: Sistema de atención médica y apoyo del VA que ofrece servicios de salud, salud mental, rehabilitación, medicamentos, equipo médico, atención para veteranos mayores, apoyo a cuidadores y otros servicios para veteranos elegibles y sus familias.
summary_en: VA health care and support system providing medical care, mental health services, rehabilitation, medications, medical equipment, geriatric care, caregiver support, and other services for eligible Veterans and their families.
description_es: Clínica ambulatoria para veteranos de Williamson County y áreas cercanas. Ofrece primary care, salud mental, laboratorio, salud de la mujer y otros servicios, coordinados a través de VA Central Texas.
description_en: Outpatient clinic for veterans in Williamson County and nearby areas. Offers primary care, mental health, lab services, women's health, and more, coordinated through VA Central Texas.
eligibility_es: Veteranos que cumplen con los requisitos de elegibilidad para recibir atención médica del VA. La elegibilidad generalmente depende del servicio militar y el tipo de baja, además de otros requisitos relacionados con el período y tipo de servicio. Los familiares y cuidadores pueden recibir ciertos servicios de apoyo, pero la atención médica del VA está principalmente destinada a veteranos elegibles.
eligibility_en: Veterans who meet VA health care eligibility requirements. Eligibility generally depends on military service and discharge status, with additional rules based on length and type of service and other circumstances. Family members and caregivers may receive certain support services, but VA health care itself is primarily for eligible Veterans.
hours_es: El horario varía según la ubicación y el servicio. Austin VA Clinic: lunes a viernes, 8:00 AM–4:30 PM; cerrado los fines de semana. Algunos servicios tienen horarios diferentes. También hay atención telefónica del VA.
hours_en: Hours vary by location and service. Austin VA Clinic: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:30 PM; closed weekends. Some services have different hours. VA telephone care is also available.
accessibility_notes_es: Los veteranos elegibles pueden solicitar atención médica del VA en línea, por teléfono, por correo o en persona. Una vez inscritos y registrados, pueden programar citas en línea o por teléfono. Algunos servicios también están disponibles mediante telehealth.
accessibility_notes_en: Eligible Veterans can apply for VA health care online, by phone, by mail, or in person. Once enrolled and registered, appointments can be scheduled online or by phone. Services may also be available through telehealth.
service_area_es: Centro de Texas – 39 condados. Cuenta con ubicaciones en Austin, Cedar Park, Temple, Waco, Brownwood, College Station, Copperas Cove y otras comunidades.
service_area_en: Central Texas – 39 counties. Locations include Austin, Cedar Park, Temple, Waco, Brownwood, College Station, Copperas Cove and other communities.
verification_notes:
Costs vary according to eligibility, priority group, income, disability status, and the specific service. Some Veterans receive care with no copay, while others may have copayments. Ask VA about individual eligibility and costs.
VA Central Texas is more than a medical provider—it is a major entry point for Veterans needing health care, benefits, social services, housing support, transportation, medical equipment, rehabilitation, and caregiver assistance. Veterans who are not yet enrolled can apply for VA health care. VA social workers can help Veterans, families, and caregivers identify and connect with community resources.
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX.

title_es: Orientación y reclamos de beneficios para veteranos
title_en: Veterans benefits counseling and claims assistance
summary_es: Oficina del Condado de Hays que ayuda a veteranos y sus dependientes a determinar su elegibilidad y solicitar beneficios federales, estatales, locales y de organizaciones sin fines de lucro.
summary_en: A Hays County office that helps veterans and their dependents determine eligibility for and apply for federal, state, local, and nonprofit benefits.
description_es: La Oficina de Servicios para Veteranos del Condado de Hays, acreditada por la Comisión de Veteranos de Texas, ayuda a los veteranos a navegar el sistema de la VA y a solicitar beneficios de programas locales, estatales, federales y de organizaciones sin fines de lucro, en colaboración con organizaciones auxiliares.
description_en: The Hays County Veterans Services Office, accredited by the Texas Veterans Commission, helps veterans navigate the VA system and apply for benefits through local, state, federal, and nonprofit programs, in partnership with auxiliary organizations.
eligibility_es: Veteranos militares de EE. UU. y sus dependientes.
eligibility_en: U.S. military veterans and their dependents.
application_steps_es: Llamar o enviar correo electrónico para programar una cita (se recomienda cita previa).
application_steps_en: Call or email to schedule an appointment (appointments encouraged).
hours_es: Lunes a viernes, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
hours_en: Monday–Friday, 8 am–5 pm.
verification_notes:
Confirmed today via two live official hayscountytx.gov URLs (both consistent on address, phone, email, hours).
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX

title_es: Servicios para Veteranos St. Michael's
summary_es: Programa de Caridades Católicas que ofrece asistencia financiera única (renta, hipoteca, servicios públicos, pagos de auto) y manejo de casos a veteranos, sus familias y cónyuges sobrevivientes en una región de 25 condados de Texas Central.
summary_en: A Catholic Charities program offering one-time financial assistance (rent, mortgage, utilities, car payments) and case management to veterans, their families, and surviving spouses across a 25-county Central Texas region.
description_es: St. Michael's Veteran Services brinda asistencia financiera de corto plazo (30-90 días) para renta o hipoteca, servicios públicos, y pagos o reparaciones de auto, además de manejo de casos, intervención en crisis (desalojo, corte de servicios) y educación financiera en inglés y español a través de una alianza con Frost Bank. El programa cubre una región de 25 condados de Texas Central.
description_en: St. Michael's Veteran Services provides short-term (30-90 day) financial assistance for rent or mortgage, utilities, and car payments or repairs, plus case management, crisis intervention (eviction, utility disconnection), and financial education in English and Spanish through a Frost Bank partnership. The program covers a 25-county Central Texas region.
eligibility_es: Veteranos de Texas de cualquier era, incluyendo Guardia Nacional y Reservistas (mínimo 90 días en servicio activo), así como familias de veteranos y cónyuges sobrevivientes que residan dentro de la región de servicio de 25 condados. Se requiere identificación con fotografía emitida por Texas.
eligibility_en: Texas veterans of any era, including National Guard and Reservists (minimum 90 days active duty), as well as veteran families and surviving spouses residing within the 25-county service region. Texas-issued photo ID required.
required_documents_es: Identificación con fotografía emitida por Texas (del solicitante, y del cónyuge si también solicita servicios).
required_documents_en: Texas-issued photo ID (for the applicant, and for the spouse if also requesting services).
application_steps_es: Llamar a la oficina más cercana de Caridades Católicas o dejar un mensaje de voz con nombre, teléfono, tipo de ayuda necesaria y condado; también se puede completar el formulario de solicitud de asistencia financiera en línea.
application_steps_en: Call the nearest Catholic Charities office or leave a voicemail with name, phone, type of assistance needed, and county; an online financial assistance request form is also available.
hours_es: Sesiones informativas mensuales el primer martes de cada mes, 1:00–2:30 p.m. (oficina de Killeen).
hours_en: Monthly information sessions on the first Tuesday of each month, 1:00–2:30 pm (Killeen office).
service_area_es: Condado de Travis, Condado de Williamson, Condado de Bastrop, Condado de Hays, Condado de Caldwell, Condado de Blanco, Condado de Burnet, Condado de Bell
service_area_en: Travis County, Williamson County, Bastrop County, Hays County, Caldwell County, Blanco County, Burnet County, Bell County
verification_notes:
Confirmed today via the official ccctx.org program page. Other office locations exist across the 25-county service region (e.g., Bryan, Temple areas per third-party listings), but only the Killeen office (with confirmed monthly info sessions) was independently verified as an in-person location, so that is the only address listed. No dedicated email address was confirmed for this specific program.
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX

title_es: Orientación y reclamos de beneficios para veteranos
title_en: Veterans benefits counseling and claims assistance
summary_es: Oficina del Condado de Bastrop que orienta a veteranos y familiares elegibles para solicitar beneficios federales, estatales y locales, incluyendo discapacidad, pensiones, educación y beneficios funerarios.
summary_en: A Bastrop County office that counsels veterans and eligible family members on applying for federal, state, and local benefits, including disability, pensions, education, and burial benefits.
description_es: La Oficina de Servicios para Veteranos del Condado de Bastrop ayuda con reclamos de discapacidad de VA, pensiones, beneficios de educación, préstamos hipotecarios, beneficios funerarios y programas de cuidador. Además de la oficina principal en Bastrop, atiende con cita en un anexo en Elgin (jueves) y en el Ayuntamiento de Smithville (miércoles).
description_en: The Bastrop County Veterans Service Office helps with VA disability claims, pensions, education benefits, home loans, burial benefits, and caregiver programs. In addition to the main Bastrop office, it holds appointment-only hours at an Elgin annex (Thursdays) and Smithville City Hall (Wednesdays).
eligibility_es: Veteranos y familiares elegibles del Condado de Bastrop.
eligibility_en: Veterans and eligible family members of Bastrop County.
application_steps_es: Llamar al (512) 581-4006 o enviar correo a veterans.service@co.bastrop.tx.us para programar una cita.
application_steps_en: Call (512) 581-4006 or email veterans.service@co.bastrop.tx.us to schedule an appointment.
hours_es:
Oficina principal (Bastrop): lunes a jueves, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m., con cita. 
Anexo de Elgin: jueves, 1:30–3:00 p.m. 
Ayuntamiento de Smithville: miércoles, 1:30–3:00 p.m.
hours_en:
Main office (Bastrop): Monday–Thursday, 8:00 am–5:00 pm, by appointment. 
Elgin annex: Thursdays, 1:30–3:00 pm. 
Smithville City Hall: Wednesdays, 1:30–3:00 pm.
verification_notes:
Confirmed today via the official bastropcounty.gov page. Recommend the admin compare organization name, phone (512) 581-4006, and address (104 Loop 150, Bastrop, TX 78602) across batches before publishing both.

title_es: Centro de recursos para veteranos y sus familias
title_en: Resource center for veterans and their families
summary_es: Centro de recursos para veteranos, militares y sus familias en Cedar Park que ofrece apoyo entre pares, asistencia con reclamos de VA y actividades familiares, de forma gratuita.
summary_en: A veteran and military family resource center in Cedar Park offering peer support, VA claims assistance, and family activities, free of charge.
description_es: El Centro de Recursos Heroes (Heroes Night Out) es una instalación de 6,000 pies cuadrados que ofrece un especialista en reclamos de beneficios, un consejero del Vet Center, exámenes de compensación y pensión de VA, un especialista en préstamos hipotecarios para veteranos, grupos de apoyo, asistencia de la Comisión de la Fuerza Laboral de Texas, café y donas entre semana, y cenas familiares gratuitas el primer viernes de cada mes.
description_en: The Heroes Resource Center (Heroes Night Out) is a 6,000 square-foot facility offering a benefits claims specialist, a Vet Center counselor, VA compensation and pension exams, a veteran home loan specialist, support groups, Texas Workforce Commission assistance, weekday coffee and donuts, and free family dinners on the first Friday of each month.
eligibility_es: Veteranos, militares en servicio activo y sus familias.
eligibility_en: Veterans, active-duty service members, and their families.
application_steps_es: Visitar el centro durante el horario de atención, o llamar/enviar correo electrónico para más información.
application_steps_en: Visit the center during business hours, or call/email for more information.
hours_es: Lunes a viernes, 9:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.
hours_en: Monday–Friday, 9 AM–4 PM
service_area_es: Condado de Travis, Condado de Williamson, Condado de Burnet
service_area_en: Travis County, Williamson County, Burnet County
verification_notes: Confirmed today via the official heroesresourcecenter.org site (address, phone, email, hours, services, free-of-charge statement). The four-county service area (Burnet, Llano, Travis, Williamson) comes from a findhelp.org directory listing rather than the organization's own site, so flagged as a secondary-source detail for admin to double-check.

title_es: Conexión Comunitaria y Bienestar para Veteranos
summary_es: Organización comunitaria que ayuda a los veteranos a fortalecer sus conexiones sociales, participar en la comunidad y encontrar oportunidades de bienestar y apoyo después del servicio militar.
summary_en: Community organization helping Veterans build social connections, engage with their community, and find opportunities for wellness and support after military service.
description_es: O.P. Veteran busca apoyar a los veteranos mediante tres pilares principales: conexión social, participación comunitaria y salud mental. Ofrece oportunidades para que los veteranos se conecten con otros veteranos, participen como voluntarios y encuentren actividades que promuevan el sentido de comunidad y propósito después del servicio militar. También organiza eventos como Game Night, abierto mensualmente a veteranos y sus familias, y Thirsty Thursday, una actividad de conexión para la comunidad de veteranos.
description_en: O.P. Veteran supports Veterans through three main pillars: social connection, community involvement, and mental health. It provides opportunities for Veterans to connect with other Veterans, volunteer, and participate in activities that promote community and a sense of purpose after military service. The organization also hosts events such as Game Night, a monthly event open to Veterans and their families, and Thirsty Thursday, a gathering focused on strengthening the Veteran community.
eligibility_es: Los veteranos pueden participar en los programas y actividades comunitarias de O.P. Veteran. Algunos eventos, como Game Night, están abiertos específicamente a veteranos y sus familias. Los requisitos de participación o registro pueden variar según el programa o evento.
eligibility_en: Veterans can participate in O.P. Veteran programs and community activities. Some events, such as Game Night, are specifically open to Veterans and their families. Eligibility or registration requirements may vary by program or event.
hours_es: El horario varía según los programas y eventos. Consulte el calendario del sitio web o comuníquese directamente con O.P. Veteran para obtener información actualizada.
hours_en: Hours vary depending on programs and events. Check the website calendar or contact O.P. Veteran for current information.
accessibility_notes_es: Visite el sitio web de O.P. Veteran para conocer los próximos eventos, programas, oportunidades de voluntariado y formas de conectarse con la comunidad de veteranos.
accessibility_notes_en: Visit the O.P. Veteran website to learn about upcoming events, programs, volunteer opportunities, and ways to connect with the Veteran community.
service_area_es: Condado de Travis, Condado de Williamson, Condado de Bastrop, Condado de Hays, Condado de Caldwell, Condado de Blanco, Condado de Burnet
service_area_en: Travis County, Williamson County, Bastrop County, Hays County, Caldwell County, Blanco County, Burnet County
verification_notes:
Cost: Varía según el programa o evento. Las actividades comunitarias pueden ser gratuitas, pero se recomienda verificar los detalles de cada evento antes de participar.

O.P. Veteran is primarily a community connection and Veteran engagement organization. It should not be presented as a direct provider of housing assistance, financial assistance, legal services, or VA benefits. For Veterans needing those services, O.P. Veteran can be a community connection point, while specialized providers such as VA or Veterans Justice Outreach should be listed separately [location-review: variable]

title_es: Comidas para veteranos y sus familias
title_en: Meals for veterans and their families
summary_es: Organización sin fines de lucro fundada por veteranos que provee comidas nutritivas a veteranos de Texas con pocos recursos económicos, así como a sus familias y cónyuges sobrevivientes.
summary_en: A veteran-founded nonprofit that provides nutritious meals to low-income Texas veterans, as well as their families and surviving spouses.
description_es: Meals for Vets cubre el costo de comidas frescas y saludables para veteranos de Texas (generalmente menores de 60 años) que enfrentan dificultades financieras y no califican para otros programas de asistencia alimentaria como Meals on Wheels. También financia comidas para veteranos mayores de 60 años en lista de espera de otros programas, y colabora con universidades para apoyar a veteranos estudiantes. Debido a la alta demanda, actualmente hay lista de espera.
description_en: Meals for Vets covers the cost of fresh, healthy meals for Texas veterans (generally under 60) facing financial hardship who don't qualify for other food assistance programs like Meals on Wheels. It also funds meals for veterans 60+ who are on waitlists for other programs, and partners with colleges to support veteran students. Due to high demand, the program currently has a waitlist.
eligibility_es: Veteranos de Texas, generalmente menores de 60 años, con pocos o ningún recurso económico, que no califican para otros programas de asistencia alimentaria; se requiere comprobante de al menos un día de servicio activo honorable. Actualmente hay lista de espera por alta demanda.
eligibility_en: Texas veterans, generally under 60, with few or no financial resources, who don't qualify for other food assistance programs; proof of at least one day of active duty service required. Currently operating with a waitlist due to high demand.
required_documents_es: Comprobante de servicio activo; documentos financieros según los requisitos de elegibilidad publicados por la organización.
required_documents_en: Proof of active duty service; financial documents per the organization's published eligibility requirements.
application_steps_es: Completar la solicitud en línea (formulario JotForm - https://mealsforvets.org/apply/), subir los documentos financieros requeridos, y esperar contacto telefónico de la organización para verificación y documentación adicional.
application_steps_en: Complete the online application (JotForm - https://mealsforvets.org/apply/), upload required financial documents, and wait for the organization to call for verification and any additional documentation.
hours_es: Horario no publicado; lista de espera activa confirmada (vigente a agosto 2026)
hours_en: Hours not published; active waitlist confirmed (as of August 2026).
verification_notes:
Confirmed today via the official mealsforvets.org apply page. The organization's Fredericksburg address is a PO Box (mailing/administrative only); meals are not received at that address in person, so all address fields were left blank. A secondary toll-free number, 800-676-1389, was also found but not used as the primary listed phone.

https://mealsforvets.org/apply/
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX

title_es: Representantes para reclamos y apelaciones de beneficios de VA
title_en: Representatives for VA benefit claims and appeals
summary_es: Representantes acreditados de la Comisión de Veteranos de Texas ayudan a veteranos y sus familias a presentar y apelar reclamos de beneficios ante el Departamento de Asuntos de Veteranos de EE. UU.
summary_en: Accredited representatives from the Texas Veterans Commission help veterans and their families file and appeal VA disability and benefits claims.
description_es: La Comisión de Veteranos de Texas (TVC) representa a los veteranos del estado ante el Departamento de Asuntos de Veteranos de EE. UU. en reclamos de discapacidad, pensiones, beneficios de sobrevivientes y apelaciones. Sus representantes de reclamos están ubicados en oficinas regionales de VA, instalaciones médicas, clínicas y bases militares en todo Texas, incluyendo la región central.
description_en: The Texas Veterans Commission (TVC) represents Texas veterans before the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs on disability claims, pensions, survivor benefits, and appeals. Its claims representatives are located at VA regional offices, medical facilities, clinics, and military installations throughout Texas, including the Central Texas region.
eligibility_es: Veteranos con baja honorable, general bajo condiciones honorables, u otra que no sea honorable; también atiende a dependientes y sobrevivientes. No se requiere calificación de discapacidad previa.
eligibility_en: Veterans with honorable, general under honorable conditions, or other than honorable discharge; also serves dependents and survivors. No prior disability rating required.
application_steps_es: Llamar a la línea gratuita de la Comisión o visitar una oficina de reclamos ubicada en una instalación de VA.
application_steps_en: Call the Commission's toll-free line or visit a claims office located at a VA facility.
address_line_1: No hay oficina única — consejeros integrados en instalaciones de VA en distintas áreas, incluida Austin
verification_notes: Could not directly verify via tvc.texas.gov today — the official site returned an 'Access Denied' bot-protection error on repeated attempts. Relied on TexVet.org's summary and general search results instead, so last_verified_at left blank. This is a statewide program with representatives distributed across many VA facilities rather than a single office, so no address was assigned — recommend admin confirm whether a specific local/regional TVC office should instead be listed for Central Texas.

title_es: Orientación y solicitudes de beneficios para veteranos
summary_es: Oficina del Condado de Caldwell que ayuda a veteranos y sus familias a solicitar beneficios de la VA, incluyendo compensación por discapacidad, pensiones y beneficios de sobrevivientes.
summary_en: A Caldwell County office that helps veterans and their families apply for VA benefits, including disability compensation, pensions, and survivor benefits.
description_es: La Oficina de Servicios para Veteranos del Condado de Caldwell asiste con reclamos de la VA (compensación por discapacidad, pensión, beneficios de sobrevivientes), obtención de documentos de baja militar, apelaciones y orientación sobre exenciones de impuestos a la propiedad para veteranos. La atención es con cita previa.
description_en: The Caldwell County Veterans Service Office assists with VA claims (disability compensation, pension, survivor benefits), retrieving discharge documents, appeals, and guidance on property tax exemptions for veterans. Services are by appointment.
eligibility_es: Veteranos del condado y sus dependientes elegibles; no hay requisitos de tipo de baja, rama militar o calificación de discapacidad.
eligibility_en: County veterans and their eligible dependents; no requirements on discharge type, branch, or disability rating.
application_steps_es: Llamar o enviar correo electrónico a la oficina para programar una cita.
application_steps_en: Call or email the office to schedule an appointment.
hours_es: Abierto con cita previa, de lunes a viernes.
hours_en: Open by appointment, Monday through Friday.
verification_notes: Confirmed today via the official Caldwell County page (address, phone, email, officer name Sara Love). Note conflict: TexVet.org lists a different address (405 East Market, Lockhart) and slightly different hours (M-Th 7am-4pm, Friday appointments/home visits only) than the county's own site — used the county's official page as authoritative. Cost was not explicitly stated as free on any source, so marked unknown.

organization_name: University of Texas Rio Grande Valley (UTRGV) / U.S. Small Business Administration
title_es: Centro de Asistencia para Negocios de Veteranos (VBOC) – UTRGV
summary_es: Programa gratuito y confidencial de asesoría empresarial para veteranos, militares en transición, miembros de la Guardia Nacional o Reserva y cónyuges militares que desean iniciar o hacer crecer un negocio.
summary_en: A free, confidential business counseling program for veterans, transitioning service members, National Guard/Reserve members, and military spouses who want to start or grow a small business.
description_es: El Centro de Asistencia para Negocios de Veteranos (VBOC) de UTRGV ofrece talleres de plan de negocios, evaluación de conceptos, análisis de factibilidad, asesoría uno a uno para emprendedores veteranos con discapacidad relacionada al servicio, y los cursos 'Boots to Business' y 'Boots to Business Reboot'. Es uno de los cuatro VBOC originales del país (desde 1999) y forma parte de la red de socios de recursos de la SBA.
description_en: UTRGV's Veterans Business Outreach Center (VBOC) offers business plan workshops, concept assessments, feasibility analysis, one-on-one counseling tailored for service-disabled veteran entrepreneurs, and the 'Boots to Business' and 'Boots to Business Reboot' courses. It is one of the original four VBOCs in the country (since 1999) and part of the SBA's resource partner network.
eligibility_es: Militares en transición, veteranos, reservistas, miembros de la Guardia Nacional y cónyuges militares interesados en iniciar o hacer crecer un pequeño negocio.
eligibility_en: Transitioning service members, veterans, reservists, National Guard members, and military spouses interested in starting or growing a small business.
application_steps_es: Completar el formulario de solicitud de asesoría ('Request for Counseling') a través del sistema de la SBA.
application_steps_en: Complete the 'Request for Counseling' form through the SBA's system.
hours_es: Horario no publicado; requiere registro previo ("Request for Counseling")
hours_en: Hours are not published; advance registration through “Request for Counseling” is required.
verification_notes: Confirmed today via the live official UTRGV VBOC page (services, cost, contact, address). Hours not stated on the official site; a third-party directory (Network of Care) lists M-F 8am-5pm but this was not independently confirmed, so hours left blank. Service area covers West/Central/South Texas broadly, not just the Rio Grande Valley.

title_es: Agencia de Área sobre el Envejecimiento del Área Capital (AAACAP) / ADRC — CAPCOG
title_en: Area Agency on Aging of the Capital Area (AAACAP) / ADRC — CAPCOG
summary_es: Centro de información y referencia que ayuda a adultos mayores, personas con discapacidad y sus cuidadores en el área capital de Texas a encontrar servicios de apoyo a largo plazo y programas de beneficios.
summary_en: An information and referral center that helps older adults, people with disabilities, and their caregivers in the Texas capital area find long-term support services and benefit programs.
description_es: El Centro de Recursos sobre el Envejecimiento y la Discapacidad (ADRC), administrado por la Agencia de Área sobre el Envejecimiento del Área Capital (AAACAP) dentro de CAPCOG, ayuda a los residentes de la región de diez condados del área capital a obtener información sobre servicios y apoyos a largo plazo, así como programas públicos de beneficios para adultos mayores, personas con discapacidad y sus cuidadores. El contacto principal es telefónico y por correo electrónico.
description_en: The Aging and Disability Resource Center (ADRC), run by the Area Agency on Aging of the Capital Area (AAACAP) within CAPCOG, helps residents of the ten-county capital area region access information about long-term services and supports, as well as public benefit programs, for older Americans, people with disabilities, and their caregivers. Primary contact is by phone and email.
eligibility_es: Adultos mayores, personas con discapacidad y sus cuidadores que residan en la región de diez condados del área capital.
eligibility_en: Older adults, people with disabilities, and their caregivers living in the ten-county capital area region.
application_steps_es: Llamar a la línea gratuita o escribir por correo electrónico para hablar con un especialista en información y referencia.
application_steps_en: Call the toll-free line or email to speak with an information and referral specialist.
hours_es: Lunes a viernes, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
hours_en: Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m.
service_area_es: Condado de Travis, Condado de Williamson, Condado de Bastrop, Condado de Hays, Condado de Caldwell, Condado de Blanco, Condado de Burnet
service_area_en: Travis County, Williamson County, Bastrop County, Hays County, Caldwell County, Blanco County, Burnet County
verification_notes: Could not re-fetch the official capcog.org ADRC page directly today (server returned 403 Forbidden on live fetch), so phone/email/address/hours/10-county service area are based on an earlier general web search summary rather than a direct read of the live official page today — treat as likely-current but not freshly re-verified, hence last_verified_at left blank. Address (6800 Burleson Road Building 310, Suite 165, Austin, TX 78744) was reported by search results but not included in this record since it's unclear whether the public can walk in for services (this is primarily a phone/email information-and-referral service) — recommend a human confirm walk-in availability and re-check capcog.org directly. Cost not explicitly stated as free anywhere found, though government I&R/ADRC services are typically free — left as unknown rather than assumed.

title_es: Orientación y apoyo para cuidadores familiares
title_en: Navigation and support for family caregivers
summary_es: Organización que ofrece consultas gratuitas de navegación de recursos, grupos de apoyo y educación gratuita para cuidadores familiares de adultos mayores en el centro de Texas.
summary_en: An organization offering free resource-navigation consultations, support groups, and free education for family caregivers of older adults in Central Texas.
description_es: AGE of Central Texas ofrece servicios de apoyo para cuidadores a través de su programa Pathways, que incluye consultas gratuitas de navegación de recursos para conectar a adultos mayores y cuidadores con servicios verificados, grupos de apoyo entre pares (presenciales y virtuales, incluyendo uno con interpretación en lenguaje de señas americano) y sesiones educativas mensuales sobre envejecimiento y cuidado. Tiene oficinas en Austin, Round Rock, el sur de Austin y Georgetown/condado de Williamson.
description_en: AGE of Central Texas offers caregiver support through its Pathways program, which includes free resource-navigation consultations connecting older adults and caregivers with vetted services, peer support groups (in person and virtual, including one with American Sign Language interpretation), and monthly educational sessions on aging and caregiving. It has offices in Austin, Round Rock, South Austin, and Georgetown/Williamson County.
eligibility_es: Cuidadores familiares de adultos mayores, locales o a distancia, en el centro de Texas.
eligibility_en: Family caregivers of older adults, local or long-distance, in Central Texas.
application_steps_es: Llamar o escribir por correo electrónico para conectarse con el Centro de Recursos e inscribirse en consultas o grupos de apoyo.
application_steps_en: Call or email to connect with the Resource Center and enroll in consultations or support groups.
hours_es: Oficina general: lunes a viernes, 7:00 a.m.–5:30 p.m. Los horarios de los grupos de apoyo varían (por ejemplo, uno el primer lunes del mes, otro semanal los viernes).
hours_en: General office hours: Monday-Friday, 7:00 a.m.-5:30 p.m. Support group meeting times vary (e.g., one on the first Monday of the month, another weekly on Fridays).
accessibility_notes_es: Uno de los grupos de apoyo presenciales en el sur de Austin cuenta con interpretación en lenguaje de señas americano (ASL).
accessibility_notes_en: One of the in-person South Austin support groups offers American Sign Language (ASL) interpretation.
service_area_es: Condado de Travis, Condado de Williamson
verification_notes: CONFLICTING SOURCES ON ADDRESS/PHONE: the official ageofcentraltx.org homepage lists HQ phone 512-451-4611 and address 7640 Guadalupe St, Austin, TX 78752, while a findhelp.org listing and an earlier search snippet showed phone 512-600-9275, email ResourceCenter@AGEofCentralTX.org, and addresses 3710 Cedar Street, Austin, TX 78705 and 9400 Alice Mae Ln, Austin, TX 78748 for the 'Resource Center'/support groups specifically. Could not resolve which is current for which specific program, so no address was included in this record and phone number used is the official homepage's main line — recommend a human confirm current program address(es) directly with AGE before publishing. Do not confuse with the separately-named 'Area Agency on Aging of Central Texas' (aaact.org / capitalaaa.org), a different organization with a similar name.

title_es: Apoyo y relevo para cuidadores de personas con demencia
title_en: Support and respite for dementia caregivers
summary_es: Organización que ofrece información, consultas gratuitas, grupos de apoyo y programas de relevo para cuidadores de personas con Alzheimer u otras demencias en el centro de Texas.
summary_en: An organization offering information, free consultations, support groups, and respite programs for caregivers of people with Alzheimer's or related dementias in Central Texas.
description_es: Alzheimer's Texas brinda información y apoyo gratuitos a personas con Alzheimer y otras demencias, así como a sus familiares, cuidadores y profesionales.
