Los servicios incluyen consultas gratuitas con especialistas certificados, grupos de apoyo dirigidos por voluntarios (en persona y virtuales), programas de relevo de 3 a 4 horas semanales sin costo, clases educativas basadas en evidencia y programas para personas en etapas iniciales de la enfermedad.
description_en: Alzheimer's Texas provides free information and support to people with Alzheimer's and other dementias, as well as their family members, caregivers, and professionals. Services include free consultations with certified specialists, volunteer-led support groups (in person and virtual), free weekly respite programs (3-4 hours), evidence-based educational classes, and early-stage engagement programs.
eligibility_es: Personas con Alzheimer u otras demencias, sus familiares, cuidadores y profesionales; área de servicio específica no confirmada más allá del centro de Texas.
eligibility_en: People with Alzheimer's or other dementias, their family members, caregivers, and professionals; specific service-area boundaries beyond Central Texas were not confirmed.
application_steps_es: Llamar a la línea de ayuda 24/7, enviar un correo electrónico, o visitar la página de contacto para inscribirse en grupos de apoyo o programas.
application_steps_en: Call the 24/7 helpline, email, or visit the contact page to sign up for support groups or programs.
hours_es: Línea de ayuda disponible las 24 horas, los 7 días de la semana.
hours_en: Helpline available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
verification_notes: Confirmed helpline phone and free/24-7 nature via official txalz.org pages. Do not confuse Alzheimer's Texas (txalz.org, independent Central Texas nonprofit) with the separately-branded Alzheimer's Association Capital of Texas Chapter (alz.org/texascapital, national affiliate) — both exist and have different helpline numbers (Alzheimer's Texas: 512-241-0420; Alzheimer's Association Capital of Texas: 800-272-3900 / 512-592-0990); this record follows the dashboard's org name 'Alzheimer's Texas' so used txalz.org data. Office address (7000 N. MoPac Expy #200, Austin) not included since support groups meet at various locations and the helpline/consultations are the primary access points, not an office visit. Exact multi-county service area not detailed on official pages.

title_es: Cuidado en el hogar para mayores y personas con discapacidad
title_en: In-home care for older adults and people with disabilities
summary_es: Organización sin fines de lucro que ofrece cuidado en el hogar y servicios de apoyo para adultos mayores y personas con discapacidad, con tarifas basadas en el ingreso, en el área de Austin.
summary_en: A nonprofit offering in-home care and support services for older adults and people with disabilities, with income-based rates, in the Austin area.
description_es: Family Eldercare brinda cuidado en el hogar y servicios integrales de apoyo a precios accesibles según el ingreso del cliente, para adultos mayores y personas con discapacidad en los condados de Travis, Williamson y Hays. Cuenta con oficinas en Austin y Georgetown, con servicios disponibles las 24 horas del día, los 7 días de la semana, y horario de atención en el vestíbulo de lunes a viernes.
description_en: Family Eldercare provides in-home care and comprehensive support services at rates based on the client's income, for older adults and people with disabilities in Travis, Williamson, and Hays counties. It has offices in Austin and Georgetown, with services available 24/7 and lobby hours Monday through Friday.
eligibility_es: Adultos mayores y personas con discapacidad en los condados de Travis, Williamson y Hays; tarifas según el ingreso del cliente.
eligibility_en: Older adults and people with disabilities in Travis, Williamson, and Hays counties; rates based on client income.
application_steps_es: Llamar a la línea de Admisión y Referidos para consultar sobre servicios.
application_steps_en: Call the Intake & Referrals line to ask about services.
hours_es: Vestíbulo: lunes a jueves, 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.; viernes, 8:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m. Servicios disponibles las 24 horas, los 7 días de la semana.
hours_en: Lobby: Monday-Thursday, 8:00 a.m.-4:00 p.m.; Friday, 8:00 a.m.-12:00 p.m. Services available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
service_area_es: Condado de Travis, Condado de Williamson, Condado de Hays
service_area_en: Travis County, Williamson County, Hays County
verification_notes: Confirmed via official familyeldercare.org contact page (Intake & Referrals number 512.483.3580, Front Desk 512.450.0844, lobby hours, address, 3-county service area). Address included since the organization publishes lobby hours implying walk-in access, but this is the main Austin office — a Georgetown office also exists and is not captured in this single-address schema. Cost/rate details limited to general 'affordable rates based on income' language, no specific fee schedule found. Email not found.

title_es: Comidas a domicilio y apoyo para adultos mayores
title_en: Home-delivered meals and support for older adults
summary_es: Organización que entrega más de 3,000 comidas al día a adultos mayores confinados en casa en el centro de Texas, además de cuidado en el hogar, reparaciones y asistencia con alimentos.
summary_en: An organization delivering more than 3,000 meals a day to homebound older adults in Central Texas, plus in-home care, home repairs, and grocery assistance.
description_es: Meals on Wheels Central Texas (MOWCT) entrega comidas a domicilio a personas mayoritariamente confinadas en casa, que no pueden preparar comidas nutritivas fácilmente, no cuentan con ayuda diurna constante y pueden recibir la entrega en el horario programado. También ofrece programas de comidas en grupo en centros para adultos mayores, cuidado en el hogar, reparaciones menores de vivienda y asistencia con alimentos. Para solicitar el servicio, se realiza una evaluación telefónica inicial.
description_en: Meals on Wheels Central Texas (MOWCT) delivers meals to people who are primarily homebound, unable to easily prepare nutritious meals, without consistent daytime assistance, and able to receive deliveries during the scheduled window. It also offers congregate meal programs at senior centers, in-home care, minor home repairs, and grocery assistance. Applying involves an initial phone assessment.
eligibility_es: Personas primordialmente confinadas en casa, que no pueden preparar comidas nutritivas fácilmente, sin ayuda diurna constante, y que puedan recibir la entrega en el horario programado.
eligibility_en: People who are primarily homebound, unable to easily prepare nutritious meals, without consistent daytime assistance, and able to accept deliveries during the scheduled time frame.
application_steps_es: Llamar al 512-477-CARE (2273) o enviar una solicitud en línea; el equipo de admisión se comunica en un plazo de 48 horas para una evaluación telefónica. Para la evaluación inicial, tener a la mano dirección, código postal, condiciones médicas, razón de la necesidad y contactos de emergencia.
application_steps_en: Call 512-477-CARE (2273) or submit an online inquiry; the intake team follows up within 48 hours for a phone assessment. For the initial intake, have your address, zip code, medical conditions, reason for needing meals, and emergency contacts ready.
hours_es: Oficina: lunes a viernes, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.; cerrado los fines de semana.
hours_en: Office hours: Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m.; closed weekends.
verification_notes: Organization's website has moved from mealsonwheelscentraltexas.org to mowctx.org (301 redirect) — update the on-file website_url if the old domain is stored elsewhere. Confirmed phone, application process, and office hours via official site and FAQ. Cost/donation amount and precise county boundaries were not stated on the pages fetched, so left as unknown/general. Kitchen/office address (3227 E 5th St, Austin, TX 78702) not included as a service address since meals are home-delivered, not picked up in person. NOT a duplicate of idx 113 or idx 114 — distinct regional Meals on Wheels affiliate serving the Austin/Travis area.

title_es: Opportunities for Williamson & Burnet Counties (OWBC) — Meals on Wheels
title_en: Opportunities for Williamson & Burnet Counties (OWBC) — Meals on Wheels
summary_es: Entrega de comidas a domicilio y comidas en grupo en centros para adultos mayores en los condados de Williamson y Burnet, para personas mayores u otras que no pueden preparar sus propios alimentos.
summary_en: Home-delivered meals and congregate meals at senior centers in Williamson and Burnet counties for older adults and others unable to prepare their own food.
description_es: OWBC, la agencia de acción comunitaria de los condados de Williamson y Burnet desde 1965, opera un programa de Meals on Wheels que entrega comidas calientes a domicilio cinco días a la semana a personas que, por enfermedad, edad o discapacidad, no pueden alimentarse adecuadamente por sí mismas. También ofrece comidas en grupo al mediodía, de lunes a viernes, en centros para adultos mayores, con compañía y socialización.
description_en: OWBC, the community action agency for Williamson and Burnet counties since 1965, runs a Meals on Wheels program that delivers hot meals to homes five days a week for people who, due to illness, age, or disability, cannot properly feed themselves. It also offers noon congregate meals Monday through Friday at senior centers, with companionship and socialization.
eligibility_es: Personas que, por enfermedad, edad o discapacidad, no pueden preparar comidas nutritivas por sí mismas; residentes de los condados de Williamson o Burnet. Requisitos específicos de edad e ingresos no confirmados.
eligibility_en: People who, due to illness, age, or disability, cannot prepare nutritious meals for themselves; residents of Williamson or Burnet counties. Specific age/income requirements not confirmed.
application_steps_es: Llamar a la organización para solicitar información sobre inscripción.
application_steps_en: Call the organization for enrollment information.
hours_es: Entrega lunes–viernes
hours_en: Delivery Monday–Friday.
service_area_es: Condado de Williamson, Condado de Burnet
verification_notes: Confirmed phone, email, and service area via official owbc-tx.org site. Cost, exact eligibility requirements (age/income), and hours were not specified on the pages available — left as unknown/blank rather than assumed. Congregate meals happen at multiple senior centers, so no single address included; the 604 High Tech Drive, Georgetown address found appears to be the administrative office, not necessarily a public meal site. NOT a duplicate of idx 113 (Combined Community Action, serves Bastrop/Blanco/Caldwell/Fayette/Hays/Lee) or idx 115 (MOWCT, serves Austin/Travis area).

title_es: Meals on Wheels Rural Capital Area
title_en: Meals on Wheels Rural Capital Area
summary_es: Entrega de comidas a domicilio y comidas en grupo para adultos mayores de 60 años en seis condados rurales del centro de Texas, con una donación voluntaria sugerida.
summary_en: Home-delivered meals and congregate meals for adults age 60 and older across six rural Central Texas counties, with a suggested voluntary donation.
description_es: Combined Community Action, Inc. administra el Programa de Nutrición para Adultos Mayores / Meals on Wheels Rural Capital Area desde 1978, sirviendo a los condados de Bastrop, Blanco, Caldwell, Fayette, Hays y Lee. Ofrece comidas entregadas a domicilio por voluntarios a personas de 60+ que no pueden salir de casa sin ayuda (y adultos con discapacidad menores de 60 con Medicaid en algunos casos), así como comidas en grupo de lunes a viernes al mediodía en varias localidades (Carmine, Giddings, La Vista, Luling, McDade, San Marcos y Smithville). Se sugiere una donación de $2.50 por comida, pero nadie es rechazado por no poder pagar.
description_en: Combined Community Action, Inc. has run the Senior Nutrition Program / Meals on Wheels Rural Capital Area since 1978, serving Bastrop, Blanco, Caldwell, Fayette, Hays, and Lee counties. It offers meals delivered by volunteers to people 60+ who cannot leave home without assistance (and some Medicaid-eligible adults with disabilities under 60), as well as congregate meals served Monday through Friday at noon at several sites (Carmine, Giddings, La Vista, Luling, McDade, San Marcos, and Smithville). A $2.50 per-meal donation is suggested, but no one is turned away for inability to pay.
eligibility_es: Personas de 60 años o más que residan en el área de servicio; para comidas a domicilio deben estar confinadas en casa sin ayuda para cocinar; también se sirve al cónyuge del beneficiario sin importar su edad, y algunos adultos con discapacidad menores de 60 años que reciben Medicaid.
eligibility_en: People age 60 or older living in the service area; home-delivered meals require being homebound without cooking help; spouses of eligible clients are also served regardless of age, and some Medicaid-eligible adults with disabilities under 60 may qualify.
application_steps_es: Llamar para solicitar el servicio; actualmente hay lista de espera en algunas áreas por limitaciones de fondos.
application_steps_en: Call to apply; a waitlist currently exists in some areas due to funding limitations.
hours_es: Comidas en grupo: lunes a viernes, alrededor del mediodía, en los sitios indicados.
hours_en: Congregate meals: Monday-Friday, around noon, at listed sites.
service_area_es: Condado de Bastrop, Condado de Hays, Condado de Caldwell, Condado de Blanco
service_area_en: Bastrop County, Hays County, Caldwell County, Blanco County
verification_notes: Confirmed via official ccaction.com program page and consistent secondary sources (donation amount, eligibility, counties served, waitlist note). No single address included because congregate meals are served at seven different sites and home-delivered meals go to clients' homes, not one office. NOT a duplicate of idx 114 (OWBC, serves Williamson/Burnet) or idx 115 (MOWCT, serves the Austin/Travis area) — these are three distinct regional Meals on Wheels affiliates covering non-overlapping counties, part of the statewide Meals on Wheels Texas network. [location-review: variable]

title_es: Programas de alimentos para adultos mayores (CSFP y HOPE)
summary_es: Programas de distribución mensual de alimentos para adultos mayores de 60 años o más en el centro de Texas, sin costo alguno.
summary_en: Monthly food distribution programs for adults age 60 and older in Central Texas, at no cost.
description_es: El Central Texas Food Bank administra dos programas para adultos mayores: el Programa Suplementario de Alimentos para Productos Básicos (CSFP), que entrega mensualmente una caja de aproximadamente 25 a 30 libras de alimentos a personas de 60+ que cumplen con los límites de ingresos del USDA, y el Programa de Opciones Saludables para Adultos Mayores (HOPE), que ofrece cerca de 15 a 20 libras de comestibles no perecederos al mes a personas de 55/60+ sin requisito de comprobar ingresos. Ambos se distribuyen en sitios específicos durante horarios de distribución anunciados.
description_en: Central Texas Food Bank runs two senior programs: the Commodity Supplemental Food Program (CSFP), which delivers a monthly box of about 25-30 pounds of food to people 60+ who meet USDA income guidelines, and the Healthy Options Program for the Elderly (HOPE), which provides about 15-20 pounds of shelf-stable groceries per month to people 55/60+ with no income documentation required. Both are distributed at specific sites during posted distribution hours.
eligibility_es: CSFP: 60 años o más y cumplir con los límites de ingresos del USDA. HOPE: 60 años o más (algunas fuentes indican 55+), sin necesidad de comprobar ingresos.
eligibility_en: CSFP: age 60+ and must meet USDA income guidelines. HOPE: age 60+ (some sources say 55+), no proof of income required.
required_documents_es: Identificación que confirme la edad.
required_documents_en: Age identification.
application_steps_es: Usar la herramienta 'Find Food Now' en el sitio del banco de alimentos y filtrar por programas para adultos mayores, luego acudir al sitio de distribución durante el horario indicado; el personal ayuda a completar una solicitud breve.
application_steps_en: Use the 'Find Food Now' tool on the food bank's website and filter for Older Adult Programs, then visit the distribution site during its listed hours; staff help complete a brief application.
hours_es: Varía según el sitio de distribución; consulte 'Find Food Now' en el sitio web.
hours_en: Varies by distribution site; check 'Find Food Now' on the website.
verification_notes: Confirmed via official centraltexasfoodbank.org senior help page (eligibility, cost = free, distribution process). Food bank's specific full county service footprint was not detailed on this page (it generally serves a large multi-county Central Texas region), so service_area left general rather than listing specific counties. No single address included since distribution happens at many partner sites found via the 'Find Food Now' tool. HOPE eligibility age appears as both 55+ and 60+ across different source snippets — noted the discrepancy in eligibility text rather than picking one.

title_es: Proyecto de Solicitud Simplificada de Texas (TSAP) — SNAP para Adultos Mayores
title_en: Texas Simplified Application Project (TSAP) — SNAP for Seniors
summary_es: Solicitud simplificada de SNAP para hogares de adultos mayores o con discapacidad.
summary_en: Simplified SNAP application for households of seniors or people with disabilities.
description_es: Solicitud simplificada de SNAP para hogares donde todos los miembros tienen 60+ años y/o reciben pago por discapacidad, con período de certificación extendido (3 años en vez de 6 meses) y sin entrevista de renovación si sigue siendo elegible.
description_en: Simplified SNAP application for households where every member is 60+ and/or receives disability payments, with an extended certification period (3 years instead of 6 months) and no renewal interview if still eligible.
hours_es: En línea 24/7 vía YourTexasBenefits.com; oficinas HHSC con horario propio
hours_en: Online 24/7 through YourTexasBenefits.com; HHSC offices have their own hours.
verification_notes: Verificado directamente por Puente ATX. [location-review: variable]

organization_name: Area Agency on Aging of the Capital Area (CAPCOG) / Texas HHSC
title_es: Agencia sobre el Envejecimiento del Área Capital (AAACAP)
title_en: Area Agency on Aging of the Capital Area (AAACAP)
summary_es: Agencia regional que conecta a adultos mayores, personas con discapacidades y cuidadores con servicios, beneficios y apoyos que ayudan a mantener la independencia y la calidad de vida.
summary_en: Regional agency that connects older adults, people with disabilities, and caregivers with services, benefits, and supports that help them maintain independence and quality of life.
description_es: La Agencia del Área sobre el Envejecimiento del Área Capital (AAACAP) ofrece servicios y apoyos para adultos mayores, personas con discapacidades y sus cuidadores en una región de 10 condados. A través de sus programas, ayuda a las personas a encontrar recursos comunitarios, comprender y solicitar beneficios públicos, recibir asesoría sobre Medicare, coordinar cuidados y acceder a servicios para permanecer independientes y envejecer en el lugar que elijan. También ofrece apoyo a cuidadores, servicios de relevo, coordinación de cuidados después de una hospitalización o crisis de salud, defensa de los derechos de residentes de hogares de cuidado a largo plazo y programas de salud, bienestar y apoyo para la demencia.
description_en: The Area Agency on Aging of the Capital Area (AAACAP) provides services and supports for older adults, people with disabilities, and caregivers across a 10-county region. Its programs help people find community resources, understand and apply for public benefits, receive Medicare benefits counseling, coordinate care, and access services that support independence and aging in place. AAACAP also provides caregiver support and respite, care coordination following hospitalization or a health crisis, advocacy for residents of long-term care facilities, and health, wellness, and dementia support programs.
keywords_es: Agencia del Área sobre el Envejecimiento
eligibility_es: Adultos mayores, generalmente de 60 años o más, personas con discapacidades, beneficiarios de Medicare y familiares u otros cuidadores. La elegibilidad varía según el programa. Algunos servicios de asesoría sobre beneficios están disponibles para beneficiarios de Medicare de cualquier edad, mientras que los programas específicos de apoyo a cuidadores y coordinación de cuidados tienen requisitos propios.
eligibility_en: Older adults, generally age 60+, people with disabilities, Medicare beneficiaries, and family or other caregivers. Eligibility varies by program. Some benefits counseling services are available to Medicare beneficiaries of any age, while specific caregiver and care-coordination programs have their own eligibility requirements.
hours_es: Los servicios se acceden principalmente por teléfono, correo electrónico o mediante cita. CAPCOG indica actualmente que sus oficinas están cerradas al público debido al trabajo remoto; los clientes deben llamar al 512-916-6062 para programar una cita presencial.
hours_en: Services are primarily accessed by phone, email, or appointment. CAPCOG currently states that its offices are closed to the public due to teleworking; clients should call 512-916-6062 to schedule an in-person appointment.
service_area_es: Condados de Bastrop, Blanco, Burnet, Caldwell, Fayette, Hays, Lee, Llano, Travis y Williamson.
service_area_en: Bastrop, Blanco, Burnet, Caldwell, Fayette, Hays, Lee, Llano, Travis, and Williamson Counties.
verification_notes:
cost: Many AAACAP/ADRC information, referral, benefits counseling, caregiver support, and coordination services are free. Some contracted or specialized services may have different eligibility or contribution requirements.

English: AAACAP is an excellent first point of contact when a family does not know which aging or disability resource they need. The ADRC uses a “no-wrong-door” approach, meaning resource navigators help identify needs and connect people with the appropriate programs and agencies. AAACAP also operates as a Benefits Enrollment Center and can provide Medicare and public-benefits counseling.
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX.

organization_name: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
title_es: 2-1-1 Texas (HHSC)
summary_es: Línea telefónica gratuita y estatal, disponible las 24 horas, que conecta a los texanos con servicios locales de alimentos, vivienda, salud, cuidado de niños y otras necesidades.
summary_en: A free, statewide phone line available 24/7 that connects Texans with local food, housing, health, child care, and other assistance services.
description_es: 2-1-1 Texas, operado por la Comisión de Salud y Servicios Humanos de Texas (HHSC), es una línea de información y referencia que usa una base de datos estatal para conectar a las personas con programas y servicios locales. Los especialistas capacitados atienden las llamadas las 24 horas, los 7 días de la semana, y ofrecen ayuda en más de 150 idiomas a través de una línea de idiomas. También hay chat en vivo disponible en inglés y español en 211texas.org.
description_en: 2-1-1 Texas, run by the Texas Health and Human Services Commission (HHSC), is an information-and-referral line that uses a statewide database to connect people with local programs and services. Trained specialists answer calls 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and offer help in more than 150 languages through a language line. Live chat is also available in English and Spanish at 211texas.org.
eligibility_es: Disponible para cualquier persona en Texas.
eligibility_en: Available to anyone in Texas.
application_steps_es: Marcar 2-1-1 o llamar al (877) 541-7905, elegir idioma y luego la opción correspondiente a la necesidad (información local, beneficios estatales, registro de asistencia en emergencias, salud mental, etc.).
application_steps_en: Dial 2-1-1 or call (877) 541-7905, choose a language, then select the option matching the need (local information, state benefits, emergency assistance registry, mental health, etc.).
hours_es: Disponible las 24 horas, los 7 días de la semana.
hours_en: Available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
verification_notes: Confirmed via official 211texas.org contact page (phone numbers, chat languages, email, 24/7 availability, no-cost). primary_category is 'recursos-financieros' per instructions carried over from dashboard, even though 2-1-1 is a general-purpose referral line spanning many categories — added 'otros-recursos' as additional_categories to reflect its broad scope. Not marked is_emergency despite handling some emergency-assistance registry calls, since it is fundamentally an information/referral line, not a crisis line itself. Alternate toll-free number (877) 541-7905 available for those who can't dial 211 directly.

title_es: CapMetro Access
summary_es: Servicio de transporte compartido bajo demanda para personas cuya discapacidad les impide usar los autobuses o el tren regulares de CapMetro en el área metropolitana de Austin.
summary_en: A shared, demand-response transportation service for people whose disability prevents them from using CapMetro's regular bus or rail service in the Austin metro area.
description_es: CapMetro Access es el servicio de paratránsito de Capital Metro para personas con discapacidades que no pueden usar el transporte fijo regular. Opera dentro de aproximadamente 3/4 de milla de las rutas fijas de autobús de CapMetro, los 7 días de la semana. Para calificar, las personas deben completar una revisión de elegibilidad (solicitud en línea Parte A más un formulario Parte B completado por un proveedor de salud, o solicitud impresa). Los viajes se reservan por teléfono o por app, y el costo por viaje sencillo es de $1.75.
description_en: CapMetro Access is Capital Metro's paratransit service for people with disabilities who cannot use regular fixed-route transit. It operates within about 3/4 mile of CapMetro's fixed bus routes, seven days a week. To qualify, applicants must complete an eligibility review (an online Part A application plus a Part B form completed by a healthcare provider, or a printed application). Trips are booked by phone or app, and a single ride costs $1.75.
eligibility_es: Personas con una discapacidad que les impide usar el autobús o tren regular de CapMetro, dentro de aproximadamente 3/4 de milla de una ruta fija; requiere revisión de elegibilidad.
eligibility_en: People with a disability that prevents them from riding regular CapMetro bus or rail service, within about 3/4 mile of a fixed route; requires an eligibility review.
required_documents_es: Solicitud de elegibilidad Parte A (solicitante) y Parte B (completada por un proveedor de atención médica).
required_documents_en: Eligibility application Part A (applicant) and Part B (completed by a healthcare provider).
application_steps_es: Completar la solicitud Parte A en línea y pedir a un proveedor de salud que complete la Parte B, o descargar e imprimir la solicitud completa y enviarla por fax, correo o email.
application_steps_en: Complete the online Part A application and have a healthcare provider complete Part B, or download and submit the full printed application by fax, mail, or email.
hours_es: Servicio los 7 días de la semana; horario de reservas aproximadamente de 4:00 a.m. a 3:59 a.m. (con excepciones).
hours_en: Service runs 7 days a week; booking hours roughly 4:00 a.m. to 3:59 a.m. (with exceptions).
accessibility_notes_es: Servicio diseñado específicamente para personas con discapacidad que no pueden usar el transporte fijo regular.
accessibility_notes_en: Service is specifically designed for people with disabilities who cannot use regular fixed-route transit.
verification_notes: Confirmed via official capmetro.org/access page: fares ($1.75/ride, $17.50 for 10-ride booklet, $46.50 monthly pass), booking phone, application process, and eligibility phone/email. No physical address included since pickup/drop-off is door-to-door, not at an office. Separate eligibility inquiries number is 512-389-7501.

title_es: Transporte público rural y médico no urgente
title_en: Rural public and non-emergency medical transportation
summary_es: Sistema de transporte público regional que ofrece autobuses, rutas bajo demanda y transporte médico no urgente en las áreas no urbanizadas de diez condados del centro de Texas.
summary_en: A regional public transit system offering fixed-route buses, on-demand rides, and non-emergency medical transportation in the non-urbanized areas of ten Central Texas counties.
description_es: CARTS presta servicios de transporte público en las zonas rurales y no urbanizadas del área capital de Texas, incluyendo CARTS NOW (viajes bajo demanda en ciudades como Bastrop, Elgin, La Grange, Lockhart, Marble Falls y Taylor), rutas de autobús Country Bus, autobuses interurbanos y transporte médico no urgente. Los viajes se solicitan por teléfono, por app o en línea, y las tarifas varían según la zona, con descuentos para adultos mayores y personas con discapacidad.
description_en: CARTS provides public transportation in the rural, non-urbanized parts of the Texas capital area, including CARTS NOW (on-demand rides in cities like Bastrop, Elgin, La Grange, Lockhart, Marble Falls, and Taylor), Country Bus fixed routes, intercity coach routes, and non-emergency medical transportation. Rides are booked by phone, app, or online, and fares vary by zone, with discounts for seniors and people with disabilities.
eligibility_es: Abierto al público general en el área de servicio; adultos mayores de 60+, personas con discapacidad y niños menores de 12 años reciben tarifa reducida (algunos servicios de Country Bus son gratuitos para adultos mayores).
eligibility_en: Open to the general public in the service area; seniors 60+, people with disabilities, and children under 12 receive discounted fares (some Country Bus service is free for seniors).
application_steps_es: Llamar al centro de reservas, programar en línea en ridecarts.com, o usar la app Token Transit para comprar pases.
application_steps_en: Call the reservations center, schedule online at ridecarts.com, or use the Token Transit app to purchase passes.
hours_es: Country Bus lun-vie 8am-4pm; paratránsito San Marcos 7am-6pm; reservación con anticipación requerida
hours_en: Country Bus: Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–4 p.m.; San Marcos paratransit: 7 a.m.–6 p.m.; advance reservations are required.
accessibility_notes_es: Todos los autobuses y camionetas de CARTS son accesibles para personas con discapacidad.
accessibility_notes_en: All CARTS buses and vans are accessible for persons with disabilities.
service_area_es: Condado de Travis, Condado de Williamson, Condado de Bastrop, Condado de Hays, Condado de Caldwell, Condado de Blanco, Condado de Burnet
service_area_en: Travis County, Williamson County, Bastrop County, Hays County, Caldwell County, Blanco County, Burnet County
verification_notes: Confirmed via official ridecarts.com site (reservations phone, fare zones, service area, senior/disability discounts). Main office address (5300 Tucker Hill Lane, Cedar Creek, TX) exists but not included since riders board at stops/stations, not at the office. Fares are zone-based ($2-$6) with half-price for seniors/disabled and free rides for seniors on some Country Bus routes — used cost_type 'paid' as the general structure since most trips require payment.

title_es: Transporte y apoyo en el hogar para adultos mayores
title_en: Transportation and in-home support for older adults
summary_es: Organización sin fines de lucro que ofrece transporte voluntario gratuito y apoyo en el hogar para adultos mayores en el centro de Texas, ayudándolos a mantenerse independientes.
summary_en: A nonprofit offering free volunteer transportation and in-home support for older adults in Central Texas, helping them remain independent.
description_es: Drive a Senior es una organización sin fines de lucro basada en voluntarios que brinda viajes gratuitos puerta a puerta (citas médicas, compras, farmacia) a adultos mayores que ya no conducen, además de paseos comunitarios en grupo, apoyo en el hogar (mantenimiento, jardinería), llamadas y visitas de amistad, y ayuda con tecnología. En agosto de 2025 se fusionaron cuatro organizaciones — West Austin Caregivers, Chariot, Drive a Senior ATX y Senior Access — para formar esta organización unificada.
description_en: Drive a Senior is a volunteer-based nonprofit that provides free door-to-door rides (medical appointments, shopping, pharmacy) for older adults who no longer drive, along with community group outings, home support (light maintenance, yard work), friendly phone calls and visits, and tech help. In August 2025, four organizations — West Austin Caregivers, Chariot, Drive a Senior ATX, and Senior Access — merged to form this unified organization.
eligibility_es: Adultos mayores que ya no conducen (edad mínima no confirmada de forma consistente entre fuentes: algunas indican 60+, otras 65+), residentes del área de servicio.
eligibility_en: Older adults who no longer drive (minimum age not consistently confirmed across sources: some say 60+, others 65+), living in the service area.
application_steps_es: Enviar una solicitud (en línea o por teléfono); un miembro del equipo se comunica para conversar sobre las necesidades del solicitante.
application_steps_en: Submit an application (online or by phone); a team member follows up to discuss the applicant's needs.
hours_es: Lunes a jueves, 9:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.; viernes, 9:00 a.m.–2:00 p.m.
hours_en: Monday–Thursday, 9:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.; Friday, 9:00 a.m.–2:00 p.m.
service_area_es: Condado de Travis, Condado de Williamson, Condado de Bastrop, Condado de Hays
service_area_en: Travis County, Williamson County, Bastrop County, Hays County
verification_notes: IMPORTANT — LIKELY DUPLICATE/MERGE: driveasenioratx.org now 301-redirects to driveasenior.org, whose own page states that West Austin Caregivers, Chariot, Drive a Senior ATX, and Senior Access merged into one organization ('Drive a Senior') as of August 2025. If another batch has a separate record for 'Drive a Senior (antes Chariot)' or 'Senior Access', it is very likely the SAME current organization as this record — flag for dedup/consolidation review. Used the 'Central' regional phone number (512-472-6339) as primary since org lists separate numbers by sub-area (North 512-310-1060, South 512-445-5552, Elgin 512-281-6553); consider whether the CSV should keep only one or list all as notes. Office address (2601 Exposition Blvd, Austin, TX 78703) exists but is not included as a service address since the service is rides/home visits, not an office you visit. Minimum age requirement is stated inconsistently across sources (60 vs 65) so left general in eligibility. Cost stated as 'free' by the org's own marketing language on multiple pages (driveasenioratx.org description, KUT article), though no rate card was found confirming zero cost in all cases. [location-review: variable]

title_es: Línea legal para adultos mayores y beneficiarios de Medicare
title_en: Legal hotline for older adults and Medicare beneficiaries
summary_es: Línea telefónica gratuita que brinda asesoría legal a texanos de 60 años o más, o beneficiarios de Medicare, sobre temas de consumo, testamentos y planificación patrimonial.
summary_en: A free phone line offering legal advice to Texans age 60 or older, or Medicare beneficiaries, on consumer issues, wills, and estate planning.
description_es: El Texas Legal Services Center opera la Línea Legal Directa para Texanos, que ofrece asesoría y orientación legal (no representación) a personas mayores de 60 años o beneficiarios de Medicare en Texas. El personal puede orientar sobre cobro de deudas, directivas anticipadas, poderes notariales, testamentos y escrituras de transferencia por causa de muerte, además de temas de Medicaid, Medicare y cuidado a largo plazo. El servicio es solo de asesoría por teléfono; no redactan documentos, negocian con terceros ni representan a la persona en corte.
description_en: Texas Legal Services Center runs the Legal Hotline for Texans, providing legal counsel and advice (not representation) to Texans age 60 or older, or Medicare beneficiaries. Staff can advise on debt collection, advance directives, powers of attorney, wills, and Transfer on Death Deeds, as well as Medicaid, Medicare, and long-term care questions. The service is phone-based advice only; it does not draft documents, negotiate with third parties, or provide courtroom representation.
eligibility_es: Personas de 60 años o más, o beneficiarios de Medicare, en cualquier parte de Texas.
eligibility_en: People age 60 or older, or Medicare beneficiaries, anywhere in Texas.
application_steps_es: Llamar a la línea directa durante horario de atención; el personal ofrece asesoría por teléfono (no representación legal ni redacción de documentos).
application_steps_en: Call the hotline during operating hours; staff provide phone-based advice (not legal representation or document drafting).
hours_es: Lunes a viernes, 8:30 a.m.–5:00 p.m. (excepto días feriados).
hours_en: Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–5:00 p.m. (except holidays).
verification_notes: Confirmed phone (800-622-2520, some sources list ext. 3), hours, and eligibility via TexasLawHelp.org directory listing and multiple secondary sources (consistent across sources). Could not find a dedicated hotline page on tlsc.org itself (site shows general chat/Ask-a-Question features and a separate HICAP program, not this specific hotline by name) — used the TexasLawHelp directory page as source_url instead. Spanish-language service delivery for this specific hotline was not confirmed in available sources, so languages left as 'en' only. Email not found for this specific program.

organization_name: Volunteer Legal Services of Central Texas
title_es: Servicios Legales Voluntarios del Centro de Texas (VLSoCT)
title_en: Volunteer Legal Services of Central Texas (VLSoCT)
summary_es: Asesoría y representación legal civil gratuita, a través de abogados voluntarios, para residentes de bajos ingresos del Centro de Texas.
summary_en: Free civil legal advice and representation, through volunteer attorneys, for low-income residents of Central Texas.
description_es: VLSoCT ofrece clínicas legales en persona y consultas por teléfono en asuntos civiles como consumo, empleo, familia, vivienda/inquilinos, quiebra, expunción y no divulgación de antecedentes, sucesiones, propiedad y testamentos. La elegibilidad se basa en ingresos del hogar, activos, área de servicio y tipo de asunto legal; solo un número limitado de solicitantes califica para servicios legales adicionales más allá de la consulta inicial. No maneja asuntos penales, de inmigración ni de derechos civiles.
description_en: VLSoCT offers in-person legal clinics and phone-based consultations on civil matters such as consumer issues, employment, family law, housing/landlord-tenant, bankruptcy, expunctions and non-disclosures, probate, real property, and wills. Eligibility is based on household income, assets, service area, and type of legal matter; only a limited number of applicants qualify for additional legal services beyond the initial consultation. It does not handle criminal, immigration, or civil rights matters.
eligibility_es: Ingreso del hogar hasta 125% de las pautas federales de pobreza (hasta 187.5% para casos como sobrevivientes de violencia doméstica); residencia en los condados de Travis, Williamson, Bastrop o Hays; sujeto a activos, tipo de asunto legal y capacidad del programa.
eligibility_en: Household income up to 125% of federal poverty guidelines (up to 187.5% for cases such as domestic violence survivors); residency in Travis, Williamson, Bastrop, or Hays counties; subject to assets, type of legal matter, and program capacity.
application_steps_es: Llamar al (512) 476-5550 o visitar vlsoct.org/get-help para más información sobre cómo solicitar servicios.
application_steps_en: Call (512) 476-5550 or visit vlsoct.org/get-help for information on how to apply for services.
service_area_es: Condado de Travis, Condado de Williamson, Condado de Bastrop, Condado de Hays
service_area_en: Travis County, Williamson County, Bastrop County, Hays County
verification_notes: Confirmed via official vlsoct.org/get-help page: cost (free), eligibility income tiers (from texaslawhelp.org listing), phone, service counties, Spanish-language page availability, and covered legal topics. No public service address found for walk-in clinics; left address blank. Note: same phone number (512-476-5550) appears associated with TRLA's Austin office in some directories — this is VLSoCT's own listed number per its official site, so kept as-is, but flagging possible directory mix-up for review.

title_es: Exención de impuestos de vivienda para mayores de 65 años
summary_es: Ayuda a propietarios de vivienda de 65 años o más a reducir sus impuestos sobre la propiedad y establecer un límite para ciertos impuestos.
summary_en: Helps homeowners age 65 or older reduce property taxes and establish a ceiling on certain taxes.
description_es: La exención Over-65 está disponible el año en que el propietario cumple 65 años y establece un tope (congelamiento) en los impuestos escolares para que no aumenten, salvo por mejoras a la vivienda. La solicitud es gratuita y se presenta ante el distrito de tasación del condado donde está ubicada la propiedad; cada condado (Travis, y equivalentes en Bastrop, Williamson, Hays y Caldwell) tiene su propio distrito de tasación central con sus propios datos de contacto.
description_en: The Over-65 exemption is available the year the owner turns 65 and creates a ceiling (freeze) on school taxes so they will not increase except for home improvements. The application is free and is filed with the appraisal district of the county where the property is located; each county (Travis, and equivalents in Bastrop, Williamson, Hays, and Caldwell) has its own central appraisal district with its own contact details.
eligibility_es: Propietarios que posean y ocupen la propiedad como su residencia principal y que cumplan 65 años en el año de la solicitud; cónyuges sobrevivientes de 55 años o más también pueden calificar con prueba del fallecimiento del cónyuge.
eligibility_en: Homeowners who own and occupy the property as their principal residence and turn 65 in the application year; surviving spouses 55 or older may also qualify with proof of the spouse's death.
required_documents_es: Copia de la licencia de conducir o identificación de Texas que muestre la dirección de la propiedad; los cónyuges sobrevivientes deben aportar prueba del fallecimiento.
required_documents_en: Copy of a Texas driver's license or ID card showing the property address; surviving spouses must provide proof of death.
application_steps_es: Presentar la solicitud de exención con la documentación requerida por correo, en línea o en persona ante el distrito de tasación del condado correspondiente. El trámite se resuelve en un plazo de hasta 90 días.
application_steps_en: Submit the exemption application with required documentation by mail, online, or in person to the relevant county appraisal district. Processing takes up to 90 days.
hours_es: Distrito de Travis: lunes, miércoles y viernes 7:45 a.m. – 4:45 p.m.; martes y jueves 9:00 a.m. – 4:45 p.m.
hours_en: Travis district: Monday, Wednesday, Friday 7:45 a.m. – 4:45 p.m.; Tuesday, Thursday 9:00 a.m. – 4:45 p.m.
verification_notes: Ficha limitada al Travis Central Appraisal District y al Condado de Travis; otros condados administran sus propias solicitudes. La categoría primaria es financiera porque la exención reduce impuestos sobre la propiedad.

organization_name: Texas Department of Family and Protective Services (DFPS)
title_es: Servicios de Protección para Adultos de Texas (APS) — Línea Estatal
title_en: Texas Adult Protective Services (APS) — Statewide Intake
summary_es: La línea estatal de Servicios de Protección para Adultos de Texas recibe reportes de abuso, negligencia o explotación de adultos mayores o con discapacidades que viven en la comunidad, las 24 horas del día.
summary_en: Texas Adult Protective Services' statewide intake line receives reports of abuse, neglect, or exploitation of older adults or adults with disabilities living in the community, 24 hours a day.
description_es: Operada por la Unidad de Admisión Estatal (Statewide Intake) del Departamento de Familia y Servicios de Protección de Texas (DFPS), esta línea recibe y evalúa reportes de abuso, negligencia, autonegligencia y explotación financiera de adultos de 65 años o más, o de 18 a 64 años con discapacidades mentales, físicas, intelectuales o del desarrollo que viven en la comunidad. Los reportes pueden hacerse por teléfono o en línea, y la ley estatal exige que cualquier persona reporte sospechas de este tipo de abuso; quien reporta de buena fe está protegido de responsabilidad civil o penal.
description_en: Operated by the Statewide Intake unit of the Texas Department of Family and Protective Services (DFPS), this line receives and screens reports of abuse, neglect, self-neglect, and financial exploitation of adults 65 or older, or adults 18-64 with mental, physical, intellectual, or developmental disabilities living in the community. Reports can be made by phone or online, and state law requires anyone to report suspected abuse of this kind; good-faith reporters are protected from civil or criminal liability.
eligibility_es: Cualquier persona puede reportar; el programa investiga casos de adultos de 65+ o de 18-64 años con discapacidades que viven en la comunidad (no en instalaciones).
eligibility_en: Anyone can make a report; the program investigates cases involving adults 65+ or adults 18-64 with disabilities living in the community (not in facilities).
application_steps_es: Llamar al 1-800-252-5400 (24/7) o reportar en línea en txabusehotline.org (respuesta en 24 horas para reportes no urgentes). Para emergencias inmediatas, llamar al 911.
application_steps_en: Call 1-800-252-5400 (24/7) or report online at txabusehotline.org (24-hour response for non-urgent reports). For immediate emergencies, call 911.
hours_es: Disponible las 24 horas del día, los 7 días de la semana.
hours_en: Available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
verification_notes: Confirmed hotline number, hours, eligibility criteria, and online reporting today via dfps.texas.gov. Marked is_emergency true because it is a 24/7 abuse/neglect/exploitation reporting line, though the DFPS page itself notes true emergencies should go to 911. Marked languages as 'en' only: the main DFPS site has an 'En Español' toggle, and the hotline very likely offers Spanish-language/interpreter support (as is standard for Texas state hotlines), but this was not explicitly confirmed on the fetched intake page, so 'es' was left off pending confirmation — recommend a quick follow-up check of the hotline's own language-access statement.

organization_name: Travis County Health and Human Services
title_es: Asistencia con Servicios Públicos del Condado de Travis (CEAP)
summary_es: Travis County Health and Human Services ofrece asistencia gratuita para pagar servicios públicos a residentes de bajos ingresos del Condado de Travis.
summary_en: Travis County Health and Human Services provides free utility bill assistance to low-income residents of Travis County.
description_es: El programa ayuda a cubrir costos de electricidad, gas natural, propano, leña, agua y basura para residentes calificados del Condado de Travis. Las solicitudes pueden completarse en línea (disponible en inglés y español), en persona en cualquiera de los seis centros comunitarios del condado, o por correo. Las solicitudes se procesan en el orden recibido a partir del 1 de enero de cada año y los solicitantes se agregan a una lista de espera.
description_en: The program helps cover electricity, natural gas, propane, firewood, water, and trash costs for qualified Travis County residents. Applications can be completed online (available in English and Spanish), in person at any of the county's six community centers, or by mail. Applications are processed in the order received starting January 1st each year, and applicants are placed on a waitlist.
eligibility_es: Residentes calificados del Condado de Travis con ingresos limitados; para CEAP se requiere prueba de ciudadanía estadounidense o estatus migratorio para al menos un miembro del hogar.
eligibility_en: Qualified Travis County residents with limited income; CEAP requires proof of U.S. citizenship or immigration status for at least one household member.
required_documents_es: Identificación con foto del gobierno, comprobante de residencia en el Condado de Travis, facturas de servicios actuales, comprobante de ingresos de 30 días de todos los miembros del hogar de 18 años o más, y (para CEAP) documentación de ciudadanía/estatus migratorio.
required_documents_en: Government photo ID, proof of Travis County residence, current utility bills, 30-day income proof for all household members 18+, and (for CEAP) citizenship/immigration documentation.
application_steps_es: Aplicar en línea en traviscountytx.gov/apply, o presentar la solicitud completa y documentos en persona, por fax o correo en cualquiera de los seis centros comunitarios del condado. Quienes tengan el servicio ya desconectado deben llamar a un centro comunitario de inmediato.
application_steps_en: Apply online at traviscountytx.gov/apply, or submit the completed application and documents in person, by fax, or by mail at any of the county's six community centers. Those already disconnected should call a community center immediately.
hours_es: Varía por centro
hours_en: Varies by center.
verification_notes: Confirmed 'free', bilingual (English/Spanish) online portal, required documents, and application process today via traviscountytx.gov. Service is delivered through six named Community Centers around Travis County rather than one address, so address fields were left blank; one example center (3518 FM 973 S, Del Valle, TX 78617, 512-854-1520) was found but is not necessarily the primary/closest one for all applicants. Phone listed is the Texas 2-1-1 statewide line (877-541-7905), which routes callers to Travis County services — a direct HHS program-specific phone number was not identified separately.

title_es: Asistencia con Servicios Públicos — OWBC (Williamson/Burnet)
summary_es: OWBC ofrece asistencia gratuita para pagar servicios de energía a hogares de bajos ingresos en los condados de Williamson y Burnet.
summary_en: OWBC provides free energy bill assistance to low-income households in Williamson and Burnet counties.
description_es: A través del Programa Integral de Asistencia Energética (CEAP), OWBC ayuda a hogares de bajos ingresos a cubrir costos de energía. No se requiere estar inscrito en manejo de casos para calificar. Las solicitudes pueden recogerse en la oficina central o en varias ubicaciones de los condados de Burnet y Williamson, y enviarse por correo, correo electrónico, fax, en línea o dejarse en persona.
description_en: Through the Comprehensive Energy Assistance Program (CEAP), OWBC helps low-income households cover energy costs. Case management enrollment is not required to qualify. Applications can be picked up at the central office or at several Burnet and Williamson County locations, and submitted by mail, email, fax, online, or dropped off in person.
eligibility_es: Hogares de bajos ingresos (hasta 150% de las pautas federales de pobreza) que sean usuarios autorizados de la cuenta de servicios públicos y residan en el Condado de Williamson o Burnet. Se requiere identificación con foto y comprobante de ciudadanía o estatus migratorio para al menos un miembro de la familia, y comprobante de ingresos de todos los residentes de 18 años o más.
eligibility_en: Low-income households (up to 150% of federal poverty guidelines) who are authorized users on the utility account and live in Williamson or Burnet County. Photo ID and proof of citizenship or immigration status is required for at least one family member, plus income verification for all household members 18 and older.
required_documents_es: Identificación con foto, comprobante de ciudadanía/estatus migratorio, comprobante de ingresos del hogar.
required_documents_en: Photo ID, proof of citizenship/immigration status, proof of household income.
application_steps_es: Completar la solicitud en línea en owbc-tx.org, o recoger una solicitud impresa en la oficina central o en ubicaciones de Burnet/Williamson, y enviarla por correo, correo electrónico, fax o en persona.
application_steps_en: Complete the application online at owbc-tx.org, or pick up a printed application at the central office or Burnet/Williamson locations, and submit it by mail, email, fax, or in person.
service_area_es: Condado de Williamson, Condado de Burnet
verification_notes: Confirmed org address, phone, email, eligibility, and 'the program is free' statement today via owbc-tx.org and findhelp.org listings. One search result noted 'the program is not currently accepting additional applications at this time; call for information' — CEAP intake can pause seasonally/when funds run out, so hours and current intake status should be double-checked close to publish time. A 2025 CEAP application PDF on the org's site suggests the program remains active as of Jan 2025. Languages offered were not explicitly confirmed (unlike the Community Action Inc. program in idx 102, which explicitly offers English/Spanish forms).

organization_name: Community Action, Inc. of Central Texas
title_es: Asistencia para pagar servicios públicos
summary_es: Ayuda a hogares de bajos ingresos de los condados de Hays, Caldwell y Blanco a pagar electricidad, gas natural o propano.
summary_en: Helps low-income households in Hays, Caldwell, and Blanco counties pay electric, natural gas, or propane bills.
description_es: A través del Programa Integral de Asistencia Energética (CEAP), la organización ofrece educación energética, evaluación de necesidades, asesoría de presupuesto, asistencia para el pago de servicios públicos, y compra de unidades portátiles de calefacción o enfriamiento en situaciones de crisis cuando hay fondos disponibles. Se da prioridad a hogares con menores ingresos, mayor carga energética, niños de 5 años o menos, personas con discapacidad, adultos mayores de 60 años, y veteranos.
description_en: Through the Comprehensive Energy Assistance Program (CEAP), the organization offers energy education, needs assessment, budget counseling, utility payment assistance, and crisis-related purchase of portable heating/cooling units when funds are available. Priority is given to households with lower incomes, higher energy burden, children age 5 and under, people with disabilities, adults 60+, and veterans.
eligibility_es: Hogares de bajos ingresos en los condados de Hays, Caldwell o Blanco; se da prioridad a personas mayores, con discapacidad, veteranos y familias con niños pequeños.
eligibility_en: Low-income households in Hays, Caldwell, or Blanco counties; priority given to seniors, people with disabilities, veterans, and families with young children.
required_documents_es: Solicitud completa con documentación de identidad e ingresos del hogar (los requisitos específicos se confirman al aplicar).
required_documents_en: Completed application with proof of identity and household income (specific requirements confirmed upon applying).
application_steps_es: Complete la solicitud de CEAP en línea o imprímala y entréguela por correo, fax o en persona. Para la oficina de Caldwell en Lockhart, llame al 512-398-4420.
application_steps_en: Complete the CEAP application online or print it and submit it by mail, fax, or in person. For the Caldwell office in Lockhart, call 512-398-4420.
hours_es: Oficina de San Marcos: lunes a viernes, 8:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m. y 1:00–5:00 p.m. Hay puntos de atención adicionales en Lockhart y Luling.
hours_en: San Marcos office: Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m. and 1:00–5:00 p.m. Additional service locations are available in Lockhart and Luling.
service_area_es: Condado de Hays, Condado de Caldwell, Condado de Blanco
service_area_en: Hays County, Caldwell County, Blanco County
verification_notes: Registro consolidado con el borrador separado de Caldwell. La página oficial confirma que CEAP atiende Hays, Caldwell y Blanco y publica puntos de atención en San Marcos, Lockhart y Luling.

organization_name: Community Action Inc. of Central Texas
title_es: Centro de Ancianos San Marcos (San Marcos Senior Citizens Center)
summary_es: El Centro de Ancianos de San Marcos ofrece actividades recreativas, de salud y de referencia para adultos mayores en San Marcos, operado por Community Action Inc. of Central Texas.
summary_en: The San Marcos Senior Citizens Center offers recreational, health, and referral activities for older adults in San Marcos, operated by Community Action Inc. of Central Texas.
description_es: El centro brinda a las personas mayores oportunidades de participar en excursiones, actividades de arte y manualidades, evaluaciones de salud, un programa de ejercicio aeróbico de bajo impacto, información y referencia a otras agencias de servicios sociales, y ayuda para completar formularios y solicitudes gubernamentales. Es financiado por la Ciudad de San Marcos, el Condado de Hays y el Consejo de Gobiernos del Área Capital (CAPCOG).
description_en: The center gives older adults opportunities for field trips, arts and crafts activities, health screenings, a low-impact aerobic exercise program, information and referral to other social service agencies, and help completing government forms and applications. It is funded by the City of San Marcos, Hays County, and the Capital Area Council of Governments (CAPCOG) Area Agency on Aging.
eligibility_es: Adultos mayores residentes del área de San Marcos / Condado de Hays.
eligibility_en: Older adult residents of the San Marcos area / Hays County.
application_steps_es: Visitar el centro en persona o llamar para más información sobre actividades e inscripción.
application_steps_en: Visit the center in person or call for more information about activities and enrollment.
hours_es: Lunes a viernes, 8:00 a.m. – 2:00 p.m.
hours_en: Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m. – 2:00 p.m.
verification_notes: Confirmed address, hours, phone (with extension 32), email, and services today via the official communityaction.com page. Cost and language-access information were not stated on the page, so left as unknown/empty rather than assumed. Phone listed as (512) 392-2427 x32 — the extension may be needed to reach the center directly.

title_es: Centro de Actividades para Ancianos del Área de Lockhart
title_en: Lockhart Area Senior Citizen Activity Center
summary_es: El Centro de Actividades para Ancianos del Área de Lockhart ofrece un espacio de convivencia, comidas de bajo costo y actividades recreativas para personas mayores en el área de Lockhart.
summary_en: The Lockhart Area Senior Citizen Activity Center provides a gathering space, low-cost meals, and recreational activities for seniors in the Lockhart area.
description_es: El centro permite a las personas, principalmente adultos mayores, socializar, jugar, leer, comer y aprender. También opera una tienda de segunda mano que vende artículos del hogar, ropa y calzado a bajo costo al público en general.
description_en: The center allows people, primarily seniors, to socialize, play games, read, eat, and learn. It also operates a thrift store selling gently-used household goods, clothing, and shoes to the general public at low cost.
eligibility_es: Principalmente adultos mayores del área de Lockhart, Condado de Caldwell; la tienda de segunda mano está abierta al público en general.
eligibility_en: Primarily seniors in the Lockhart area, Caldwell County; the thrift store is open to the general public.
application_steps_es: Visitar el centro en persona durante el horario de atención.
application_steps_en: Visit the center in person during open hours.
hours_es: Tienda de segunda mano: lunes a jueves, 12:00 p.m. – 3:00 p.m. (horario general del centro no confirmado).
hours_en: Thrift store: Monday–Thursday, 12:00 p.m. – 3:00 p.m. (general center hours not confirmed).
verification_notes: COULD NOT FULLY VERIFY via a live official source today: the city's own senior-center page (cityoflockhart.gov/page/community_senior_center, redirected from lockhart-tx.org) returned a 404 error when fetched. Address (901 Bois D'Arc St, Lockhart, TX 78644) and phone (512-398-6322) are corroborated across multiple third-party listings (findhelp.org, newlifestyles.com, Yelp) but not confirmed on an official city or org page today, so last_verified_at was left blank. Organization name discrepancy: dashboard lists 'Ciudad de Lockhart' (City of Lockhart) as the organization, but CauseIQ/GuideStar-type records suggest 'Lockhart Area Senior Activity Center Inc' may be a separately incorporated nonprofit rather than a city department — recommend confirming which entity actually operates the center before publishing. General center operating hours (beyond the thrift store) were not found.

title_es: Actividades, ejercicio y comidas para adultos mayores
title_en: Activities, exercise, and meals for older adults
summary_es: Centro comunitario para adultos mayores en Bastrop que ofrece actividades sociales, clases de ejercicio y comidas comunitarias mediante una membresía anual de bajo costo.
summary_en: Community center for older adults in Bastrop offering social activities, exercise classes, and community meals through a low-cost annual membership.
description_es: El centro ofrece clases de acondicionamiento físico (incluyendo yoga y voleibol en silla), bingo, bridge, quilting, baile, y talleres educativos sobre diabetes, nutrición y tecnología básica. Se realiza un almuerzo comunitario los jueves y una cena comunitaria los martes seguida de baile con banda en vivo. La mayoría de los programas son de acceso libre (drop-in) con una donación de membresía sugerida de $25 al año; algunos programas pueden tener costos adicionales.
description_en: The center offers fitness classes (including chair yoga and chair volleyball), bingo, bridge, quilting, dancing, and educational workshops on diabetes, nutrition, and basic technology. A community potluck lunch is held Thursdays, and a potluck dinner is held Tuesdays followed by dancing with a live band. Most programs are drop-in with a suggested $25/year membership donation; some programs may have additional costs.
eligibility_es: Adultos mayores de la comunidad de Bastrop; se sugiere una donación de membresía de $25 al año.
eligibility_en: Older adults in the Bastrop community; a $25/year membership donation is suggested.
application_steps_es: Visitar el centro durante su horario de atención para inscribirse como miembro.
application_steps_en: Visit the center during operating hours to sign up for membership.
hours_es: Domingo 1:00–5:00 p.m.; lunes 9:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m.; martes y miércoles 9:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m.; jueves 9:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.; viernes 9:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m.; sábado cerrado.
hours_en: Sunday 1:00–5:00 p.m.; Monday 9:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m.; Tuesday & Wednesday 9:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m.; Thursday 9:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.; Friday 9:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m.; Saturday closed.
verification_notes: Could not directly fetch bastropcommunityseniorcenter.org (tool returned no usable content); hours, address, and membership fee were compiled from third-party listings (Bastrop Chamber of Commerce, SeniorCenters.com, findhelp.org) which may be stale — recommend confirming directly with the center (512-303-0072) before publishing. Note: phone number is identical in format style to Bastrop County Emergency Food Pantry's area but is a different number (512-303-0072 vs 512-303-0033) — visually similar, easy to transpose, double-check when entering data.

organization_name: Travis County Health and Human Services
title_es: engAGE Travis County
summary_es: engAGE Travis County es un programa gratuito de voluntariado del Condado de Travis para adultos de 50 años o más que busca fomentar la participación cívica y el envejecimiento activo.
summary_en: engAGE Travis County is a free volunteer program run by Travis County for adults age 50 and up, aimed at fostering civic engagement and active aging.
description_es: El programa recluta y coloca a personas mayores de 50 años en asignaciones de voluntariado en organizaciones sin fines de lucro de todo el Condado de Travis, emparejándolas según sus habilidades e intereses. La membresía es gratuita e incluye servicios de información y referencia sobre voluntariado, reembolso limitado de millaje, capacitaciones y eventos, y seguro suplementario de accidentes y responsabilidad civil.
description_en: The program recruits and places adults 50 and older into volunteer assignments with nonprofits throughout Travis County, matching them by skills and interests. Membership is free and includes volunteer information and referral services, limited mileage reimbursement, trainings and events, and supplemental accident and liability insurance.
eligibility_es: Personas de 50 años o más que residan en el Condado de Travis.
eligibility_en: Individuals age 50 and older residing in Travis County.
application_steps_es: Llamar al programa, visitar engagetraviscounty.org, o acudir a un centro comunitario del condado para inscribirse y ser emparejado con una asignación de voluntariado.
application_steps_en: Call the program, visit engagetraviscounty.org, or visit a county community center to enroll and be matched with a volunteer assignment.
verification_notes: Confirmed program description, eligibility (50+), free membership, and phone today via traviscountytx.gov and engagetraviscounty.org. An administrative address (5325 Airport Blvd, 2nd Floor, Austin, TX 78751) is listed for the program, but it was not explicitly confirmed as a walk-in public service location (vs. a mailing/admin address), so address fields were left empty per the rule against assuming in-person service without evidence. No language-access information was found.

title_es: Guía de servicios para adultos mayores
summary_es: El Condado de Williamson publica una guía en línea con referencias a organizaciones de salud, alimentos, transporte, servicios legales y otros recursos para residentes mayores.
summary_en: Williamson County publishes an online guide with referrals to health, food, transportation, legal, and other resources for senior residents.
description_es: Esta página del condado no es un programa directo, sino un directorio curado de recursos externos organizados en categorías: salud y bienestar, líneas de ayuda, oficinas de policía, servicios legales, asistencia alimentaria, servicios sociales, transporte y una línea de alerta de fraude de registros de propiedad. La mayoría de los recursos listados son operados por organizaciones sin fines de lucro, iglesias o agencias regionales distintas al condado; solo el Distrito de Salud de Williamson County & Cities y la línea de Alerta de Fraude del Secretario del Condado son operados directamente por el condado.
description_en: This county page is not a direct program but a curated directory of external resources organized into categories: health and wellness, hotlines, law enforcement offices, legal services, meal assistance, social services, transportation, and a property fraud alert line. Most listed resources are operated by nonprofits, churches, or regional agencies other than the county itself; only the Williamson County & Cities Health District and the County Clerk Fraud Alert line are directly operated by the county.
eligibility_es: Residentes mayores del Condado de Williamson que buscan referencias a recursos comunitarios.
eligibility_en: Senior residents of Williamson County seeking referrals to community resources.
application_steps_es: Consultar la página web del condado para encontrar el recurso específico y contactar directamente a esa organización.
application_steps_en: Browse the county webpage to find the specific resource and contact that organization directly.
verification_notes: IMPORTANT: this record's title implies a specific 'Senior Services' program, but the page is actually a referral directory of mostly external/nonprofit resources, not a direct county service — flagging for category/description review. No dedicated phone, email, or physical office for 'senior services' itself was found (only sub-agency numbers like the health district). Left address, phone, and county empty because there is no single service-delivery location. Recommend admins confirm whether this record should instead point to a specific program (e.g., Williamson County & Cities Health District) or remain a general directory listing.

title_es: Apoyo integral para adultos mayores y cuidadores
title_en: Comprehensive support for older adults and caregivers
summary_es: Organización sin fines de lucro que ayuda a adultos mayores y cuidadores familiares a navegar el envejecimiento y el cuidado mediante orientación, planificación, grupos de apoyo, educación, centros de bienestar y otros servicios comunitarios.
summary_en: Nonprofit organization helping older adults and family caregivers navigate aging and caregiving through resource navigation, care planning, support groups, education, wellness centers, and other community services.
description_es: AGE of Central Texas ayuda a adultos mayores y cuidadores familiares a enfrentar los desafíos del envejecimiento y el cuidado. Su programa Pathways ofrece navegación gratuita de recursos, grupos de apoyo, educación y planificación de cuidados. El equipo puede ayudar a identificar necesidades, encontrar servicios comunitarios, desarrollar un plan de cuidado y conectar a las familias con médicos, cuidadores y otros recursos. AGE también opera los Thrive Social & Wellness Centers, que ofrecen cuidado diurno para adultos mayores con necesidades físicas o cognitivas, incluyendo monitoreo de salud, comidas, actividades, apoyo personal y transporte puerta a puerta sin costo para miembros, sujeto a disponibilidad. También ofrece clases de tecnología y un programa de préstamo de equipo médico.
description_en: AGE of Central Texas helps older adults and family caregivers navigate the challenges and opportunities of aging and caregiving. Its Pathways program provides free resource navigation, support groups, education, and care planning. Staff can help identify needs, locate community services, develop a care plan, and connect families with doctors, caregivers, and other resources. AGE also operates Thrive Social & Wellness Centers providing daytime care for older adults with physical or cognitive needs, including health monitoring, meals, activities, personal support, and free door-to-door transportation for members when available. AGE also offers technology classes and a health equipment lending program.
eligibility_es: Adultos mayores y cuidadores familiares. Los requisitos específicos dependen del programa. Pathways atiende a personas que enfrentan desafíos relacionados con el cuidado de adultos mayores, familias que cuidan a personas con discapacidades físicas, pérdida de memoria u otras necesidades, y personas que necesitan apoyo para mantener su independencia. Los Centros Thrive tienen requisitos adicionales de inscripción y atención.
eligibility_en: Older adults and family caregivers. Specific eligibility varies by program. Pathways serves people facing eldercare challenges, families caring for loved ones with physical disabilities, memory loss or other needs, and people seeking help maintaining independence. Thrive Centers have additional enrollment and care requirements.
hours_es:
Oficina principal: lunes a viernes, 7:00 AM–4:00 PM. 
Centros Thrive: lunes a viernes, 7:00 AM–5:30 PM. 
Los diferentes programas y citas pueden tener horarios específicos.
hours_en: Main office: Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–4:00 PM. Thrive Social & Wellness Centers: Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–5:30 PM. Individual programs and appointments may have different schedules.
accessibility_notes_es: Llame o envíe un correo electrónico a AGE para solicitar información, programar una consulta gratuita de navegación de recursos, participar en un grupo de apoyo, solicitar información sobre planificación de cuidados o conocer el proceso de inscripción en un Centro Thrive. Algunos servicios requieren solicitud, evaluación o cita.
accessibility_notes_en: Call or email AGE to request information, schedule a free resource-navigation consultation, join a support group, inquire about care planning, or learn about enrollment in a Thrive Center. Some services require an application, assessment, or appointment.
service_area_es: Centro de Texas, incluyendo los condados de Travis y Williamson, con programas que también atienden partes de la región circundante.
service_area_en: Central Texas, including Travis and Williamson Counties, with programs also serving parts of the surrounding region.
verification_notes: Verificado el 2026-09-03 con el sitio oficial de AGE of Central Texas. El costo depende del programa: Pathways ofrece servicios gratuitos y Thrive acepta distintas formas de pago. El borrador específico de Pathways se conserva para revisión como posible programa independiente.

organization_name: Drive a Senior Central Texas (antes "Senior Access")
title_es: Drive a Senior – Transporte y Apoyo para Adultos Mayores
title_en: Drive a Senior – Transportation & Support for Older Adults
summary_es: Organización sin fines de lucro que ofrece transporte gratuito y servicios de apoyo para ayudar a los adultos mayores a mantenerse independientes, conectados con su comunidad y viviendo en sus hogares.
summary_en: Nonprofit organization providing free transportation and support services to help older adults remain independent, connected to their communities, and living safely at home.
description_es: Drive a Senior es una organización sin fines de lucro que ayuda a los adultos mayores a mantener su independencia y envejecer en casa mediante transporte y servicios de apoyo. Ofrece viajes puerta a puerta para citas médicas, compras de alimentos, farmacia, bancos y actividades sociales, además de viajes grupales semanales. También ofrece apoyo ligero en el hogar, pequeñas reparaciones, ayuda con tecnología, visitas amistosas y llamadas de acompañamiento. Los servicios son gratuitos para los adultos mayores elegibles.
description_en: Drive a Senior is a nonprofit organization that helps older adults remain independent and age in place through transportation and support services. Services include door-to-door rides for medical appointments, grocery shopping, pharmacy visits, banking, and social activities, as well as weekly group rides. The organization also provides light home support, minor repairs, technology assistance, friendly visits, and check-in calls. Services are free for eligible older adults.
eligibility_es: Adultos mayores que cumplan con los requisitos de elegibilidad y vivan dentro del área de servicio correspondiente. El antiguo programa Senior Access requería tener 65 años o más, vivir dentro de sus límites geográficos, vivir de manera independiente o con familia, poder movilizarse sin utilizar silla de ruedas y no tener demencia severa. Se recomienda confirmar los requisitos actuales directamente con Drive a Senior debido a la reciente integración de los programas.
eligibility_en: Older adults who meet the organization's eligibility requirements and live within the applicable service area. The former Senior Access program required clients to be 65 or older, live within its geographic boundaries, live independently or with family, be mobile without using a wheelchair, and not have severe dementia. Current eligibility should be confirmed with Drive a Senior because the former programs have now merged.
hours_es: Los servicios se programan según las necesidades del cliente y la disponibilidad de voluntarios. Los viajes deben solicitarse con anticipación. La disponibilidad actual depende del área de servicio y del programa.
hours_en: Services are scheduled based on client needs and volunteer availability. Ride requests should be submitted in advance. The former Senior Access program accepted ride requests Monday–Friday; current service availability depends on the service area and program.
service_area_es: Centro de Texas, incluyendo partes de los condados de Travis, Williamson, Bastrop y Hays. Las áreas incluyen Austin norte/centro/oeste, Travis sur/suroeste/sureste, Elgin, norte de Hays County, Round Rock, Pflugerville, Hutto y Manor.
service_area_en: Central Texas, including parts of Travis, Williamson, Bastrop, and Hays Counties. Service areas include North/Central/West Austin, South/Southwest/Southeast Travis County, Elgin, Northern Hays County, Round Rock, Pflugerville, Hutto, and Manor.
verification_notes:
Servicios: Transporte puerta a puerta; viajes a citas médicas, supermercados, farmacias, bancos y actividades sociales; viajes grupales semanales; apoyo ligero en el hogar; pequeñas reparaciones y trabajo de jardinería; visitas amistosas; llamadas de acompañamiento; ayuda básica con tecnología.

Senior Access is now part of Drive a Senior. Senior Access, Drive a Senior ATX, and Chariot joined together in August 2025. The former Senior Access service area continues to be particularly relevant to Round Rock, Pflugerville, Hutto, Manor, and East Austin. Eligibility and availability should be confirmed before referring a client.
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX.

organization_name: Cerebral Palsy Awareness Transition Hope (CPATH Texas)
title_es: Armario de Equipo Adaptativo y de Movilidad – CPATH
summary_es: Programa gratuito que proporciona de forma permanente equipo adaptativo y de movilidad a personas y familias que lo necesitan, según la disponibilidad del inventario.
summary_en: Free program providing permanent adaptive and mobility equipment to individuals and families in need, based on available inventory.
description_es: CPATH facilita la reutilización y redistribución de equipo adaptativo, de movilidad y equipo médico duradero que ya no es utilizado por otras personas. El programa proporciona gratuitamente y de forma permanente artículos como sillas de ruedas, andadores, standers, asientos de auto adaptados y bicicletas adaptativas, según disponibilidad. El programa está enfocado principalmente en equipo pediátrico, pero las personas o familias que necesiten equipo pueden consultar directamente el inventario disponible para determinar si existe un artículo apropiado para sus necesidades.
description_en: CPATH facilitates the reuse and redistribution of adaptive, mobility, and durable medical equipment that is no longer being used by others. The program provides items such as wheelchairs, walkers, standers, adaptive car seats, and adaptive bikes free of charge and on a permanent basis, depending on availability. The program primarily focuses on pediatric equipment, but individuals and families who need equipment can check the available inventory to determine whether an appropriate item is available for their needs.
eligibility_es: Personas y familias que necesiten equipo adaptativo o de movilidad disponible. El programa se enfoca principalmente en equipo pediátrico.
