title_es: Empleo y capacitación laboral — Oficina de Bastrop
title_en: Employment and job training — Bastrop office
summary_es: Oficina local de Workforce Solutions en Bastrop que ofrece servicios de empleo, capacitación laboral y apoyo relacionado, sin costo, para residentes del área.
summary_en: Local Workforce Solutions office in Bastrop offering job search help, workforce training, and related support services at no cost to area residents.
description_es: La oficina de Bastrop de Workforce Solutions Rural Capital Area brinda servicios de empleo tales como búsqueda de trabajo, referencias a capacitación laboral, e información sobre otros programas de la agencia (incluidos beneficios de desempleo y cuidado infantil). Es una de las oficinas físicas de la agencia regional que cubre el área de Rural Capital.
description_en: The Bastrop office of Workforce Solutions Rural Capital Area provides employment services such as job search assistance, referrals to workforce training, and information about the agency's other programs (including unemployment benefits and child care assistance). It is one of the regional agency's physical office locations serving the Rural Capital area.
eligibility_es: Abierto al público en general que busca servicios de empleo o capacitación; programas específicos (como cuidado infantil) tienen sus propios criterios de elegibilidad.
eligibility_en: Open to the general public seeking employment or training services; specific programs (such as child care) have their own eligibility criteria.
application_steps_es: Visitar la oficina en persona durante horario de atención o llamar para más información.
application_steps_en: Visit the office in person during business hours or call for more information.
hours_es: Lunes a viernes, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
hours_en: Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
verification_notes: Address, phone, and hours corroborated across multiple sources (Bastrop Chamber of Commerce listing, Bastrop EDC directory, unemploymentofficelocations.net) referencing the WSRCA Bastrop office page; could not directly fetch the office's own page (fetch tool blocked), so treat address/hours as good-confidence but not directly primary-source verified. Related to idx 28 (WSRCA Child Care Services) — same parent organization; this record is the physical Bastrop office while idx 28 is the region-wide child care subsidy program. Flagging both for review to confirm they should remain separate directory entries.

title_es: Salvation Army — Unidad de Servicio del Condado de Bastrop
title_en: The Salvation Army — Bastrop County TX Service Unit
summary_es: Asistencia de emergencia con renta y servicios públicos para residentes del Condado de Bastrop que enfrentan una crisis financiera.
summary_en: Emergency rent and utility assistance for Bastrop County residents facing a financial crisis.
description_es: La Unidad de Servicio del Condado de Bastrop del Ejército de Salvación (parte del programa de Extensión de Servicio de Texas, coordinado desde Austin) ayuda a familias e individuos con avisos de corte de servicios, renta atrasada u otras dificultades financieras mediante asistencia de emergencia para renta y utilities, y en algunos casos ayuda con medicamentos o transporte.
description_en: The Bastrop County TX Service Unit of The Salvation Army (part of the Texas Service Extension program, coordinated from Austin) helps families and individuals facing shut-off notices, back rent, or other financial hardship through emergency rent and utility assistance, and in some cases help with prescriptions or transportation.
eligibility_es: Residentes del Condado de Bastrop que enfrentan una emergencia financiera, aviso de corte de servicios u otra dificultad; criterios específicos de ingreso no confirmados.
eligibility_en: Bastrop County residents facing a financial emergency, shut-off notice, or other hardship; specific income criteria not confirmed.
application_steps_es: Llamar para solicitar asistencia; el servicio se coordina a través de la oficina del Ejército de Salvación en Austin.
application_steps_en: Call to request assistance; service is coordinated through The Salvation Army's Austin office.
hours_es: Lunes a viernes, 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
hours_en: Monday–Friday, 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
verification_notes: The official salvationarmyusa.org Bastrop unit page confirmed the service unit exists but did not itself list phone/hours/cost; phone (512-933-0600) and Mon–Fri 9-5 hours were corroborated across two independent web-search summaries (not a single official page fetch), and cost/eligibility specifics were not confirmed on any official page, so cost_type is 'unknown' and last_verified_at left blank. No confirmed physical service address for in-person visits was found (service appears to be phone-intake, coordinated via Austin); recommend a follow-up call to confirm current number and process before publishing.

title_es: Ayuda Legal RioGrande de Texas (TRLA)
summary_es: Asesoría legal civil, representación y educación legal gratuitas para personas de bajos ingresos en 68 condados de Texas, incluido el área de Austin/Centro de Texas que cubre el Condado de Bastrop.
summary_en: Free civil legal advice, representation, and legal education for low-income people in 68 Texas counties, including the Austin/Central Texas area covering Bastrop County.
description_es: TRLA es una organización de asistencia legal gratuita que atiende asuntos de familia, empleo, ejecución hipotecaria, quiebra, ayuda en casos de desastre, vivienda subsidiada, derechos de trabajadores agrícolas, derechos civiles y derecho ambiental, entre otros. La oficina de Austin atiende a los condados de Bastrop, Blanco, Burnet, Caldwell, Hays, Llano, Mason, Travis y Williamson. Los servicios se solicitan por la línea telefónica central gratuita.
description_en: TRLA is a free civil legal aid organization handling family law, employment, foreclosure, bankruptcy, disaster relief, subsidized housing, farmworker rights, civil rights, and environmental law, among other areas. Its Austin office serves Bastrop, Blanco, Burnet, Caldwell, Hays, Llano, Mason, Travis, and Williamson counties. Services are requested through the central toll-free line.
eligibility_es: Personas de bajos ingresos, generalmente hasta el 200% de las pautas federales de pobreza según el tipo de caso; residencia en el área de servicio de la oficina (incluye el Condado de Bastrop).
eligibility_en: Low-income individuals, generally up to 200% of federal poverty guidelines depending on case type; residency within the office's service area (includes Bastrop County).
application_steps_es: Llamar a la línea central gratuita (833) 329-8752, de lunes a viernes, 9 a.m.–5 p.m., para solicitar servicios legales.
application_steps_en: Call the central toll-free line at (833) 329-8752, Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m., to apply for legal services.
hours_es: Lunes a viernes, 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
hours_en: Monday–Friday, 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
service_area_es: Condado de Travis, Condado de Williamson, Condado de Bastrop, Condado de Hays, Condado de Caldwell, Condado de Blanco, Condado de Burnet
service_area_en: Travis County, Williamson County, Bastrop County, Hays County, Caldwell County, Blanco County, Burnet County
verification_notes: Confirmed core facts (toll-free intake line, hours, free services, English/Spanish availability, Austin office address serving Bastrop) via trla.org/offices and trla.org/help plus texaslawhelp.org and WomensLaw.org directory listings. Intake is centralized by phone rather than walk-in at the Austin office, so treat the address as the regional office location rather than a guaranteed in-person intake point.

title_es: Servicios legales de inmigración
summary_es: Organización sin fines de lucro que ofrece servicios legales de inmigración gratuitos o de bajo costo, además de educación y defensoría, para inmigrantes, refugiados y sobrevivientes de persecución, tortura, conflicto y trata de personas en el Centro de Texas.
summary_en: A nonprofit providing free or low-cost immigration legal services, education, and advocacy for immigrants, refugees, and survivors of persecution, torture, conflict, and trafficking in Central Texas.
description_es: American Gateways brinda representación y asesoría legal en inmigración —incluyendo asilo, peticiones VAWA, visas T y U, defensa ante la Corte de Inmigración de San Antonio, residencia permanente, naturalización, DACA y peticiones familiares— a personas de bajos ingresos que cumplen con los criterios de elegibilidad de la organización. Atiende con cita previa en sus oficinas de Austin, San Antonio y Waco, y no discrimina por raza, religión, nacionalidad, género u orientación sexual.
description_en: American Gateways provides immigration legal representation and advice — including asylum, VAWA petitions, T and U visas, defense in San Antonio Immigration Court, permanent residency, naturalization, DACA, and family-based petitions — to low-income individuals who meet the organization's eligibility criteria. Services are by appointment at its Austin, San Antonio, and Waco offices, and it does not discriminate based on race, religion, nationality, gender, or sexual orientation.
eligibility_es: Personas que cumplan con los límites de ingreso y prioridades de casos de la organización; no se discrimina por raza, religión, nacionalidad, género u orientación sexual.
eligibility_en: Individuals who meet the organization's income guidelines and case priorities; no discrimination based on race, religion, nationality, gender, or sexual orientation.
application_steps_es: Llamar a la oficina de Austin para programar una cita (atención solo con cita previa).
application_steps_en: Call the Austin office to schedule an appointment (by appointment only).
hours_es: 2ª y 4ª semana del mes, L–J 9am–5pm (Austin)
hours_en: Second and fourth weeks of each month, Monday–Thursday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m. (Austin).
verification_notes: Confirmed via official americangateways.org homepage: services, eligibility framing, cost, Austin/San Antonio/Waco office addresses, by-appointment-only access. Spanish-language service confirmed via the organization's Línea de Defensa Comunitaria / Deportation Crisis Hotline (512-270-1515), a separate crisis line not used as the main phone number. The dedicated /legal-services and /get-help pages returned 404 at time of check; used homepage content instead.

title_es: Autoayuda Legal — Juez de Paz, Precinto 1, Condado de Bastrop
title_en: Bastrop County Justice of the Peace Pct. 1 Self-Help
summary_es: Recursos y formularios de autoayuda legal del tribunal del Juez de Paz del Precinto 1 del Condado de Bastrop para personas que se representan a sí mismas.
summary_en: Self-help legal resources and court forms from the Bastrop County Justice of the Peace Precinct 1 court for people representing themselves.
description_es: El tribunal del Juez de Paz, Precinto 1, del Condado de Bastrop ofrece formularios y guías para personas que se representan a sí mismas en casos de reclamos menores, desalojo (desahucio) y otros asuntos de menor cuantía, incluyendo solicitudes de exención de cuotas por indigencia. También enlaza a recursos externos como el Centro de Capacitación de los Tribunales de Justicia de Texas y la Asociación de Abogados de Austin.
description_en: The Bastrop County Justice of the Peace, Precinct 1 court provides forms and guidance for self-represented litigants in small claims, eviction, and other lower-value civil matters, including indigency fee-waiver requests. It also links to outside resources such as the Texas Justice Court Training Center and the Austin Bar Association.
eligibility_es: Abierto al público que necesite presentar o responder a un caso ante el Juez de Paz, Precinto 1, del Condado de Bastrop; hay formularios de indigencia para quienes no puedan pagar las cuotas judiciales.
eligibility_en: Open to the public needing to file or respond to a case before the Bastrop County JP Precinct 1 court; indigency forms are available for those unable to pay court fees.
application_steps_es: Descargar los formularios necesarios del sitio del condado o acudir al tribunal en el Palacio de Justicia del Condado de Bastrop; llamar para preguntas.
application_steps_en: Download the needed forms from the county site or visit the court at the Bastrop County Courthouse; call with questions.
hours_es: Lun–Vie 8am–4pm; español disponible L–V 8am–3pm (representante bilingüe)
hours_en: Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–4 p.m.; Spanish is available Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–3 p.m. through a bilingual representative.
verification_notes: Confirmed via official Bastrop County government pages (jp1 and jp1.rules_information). Court hours not published on the site; not included. A third-party site (claimspages.com) listed a different address (803 Pine Street) which appears outdated/unofficial — used the address from the official county page instead.

title_es: Servicio de Referencia e Información de Abogados (LRIS)
summary_es: Servicio telefónico estatal que conecta al público con abogados según el tipo de caso legal y el condado, con una primera consulta de bajo costo.
summary_en: A statewide phone service that connects the public with attorneys based on legal issue and county, offering a low-cost initial consultation.
description_es: El Servicio de Referencia e Información de Abogados (LRIS) del Colegio de Abogados de Texas conecta a las personas con abogados en más de 246 condados de Texas según su condado y tipo de asunto legal. El personal recopila información sobre el problema legal y brinda una referencia directa; la persona debe luego contactar al abogado para agendar una consulta. La consulta inicial de hasta 30 minutos cuesta no más de $20; honorarios adicionales se negocian directamente entre cliente y abogado. No es un servicio de asistencia legal gratuita; para eso remite a TexasLawHelp.org.
description_en: The State Bar of Texas's Lawyer Referral & Information Service (LRIS) connects the public with attorneys in over 246 Texas counties based on county and type of legal matter. Staff gather information about the legal issue and provide a direct referral; the caller must then contact the attorney to schedule a consultation. The initial consultation, up to 30 minutes, costs no more than $20; additional fees are negotiated directly between client and attorney. This is not a free/reduced-fee legal aid program; for that, callers are referred to TexasLawHelp.org.
eligibility_es: Abierto al público en general en los condados de Texas atendidos por el servicio (seis condados grandes —Bexar, Dallas, Harris, Jefferson, Travis y Tarrant— cuentan con servicios de referencia locales certificados aparte).
eligibility_en: Open to the general public in the Texas counties served by LRIS (six major counties — Bexar, Dallas, Harris, Jefferson, Travis, and Tarrant — have their own certified local referral services instead).
application_steps_es: Llamar al (800) 252-9690 o usar texasbar.com/selfservice; el personal pregunta el condado y el tipo de asunto legal y da una referencia directa a un abogado participante.
application_steps_en: Call (800) 252-9690 or use texasbar.com/selfservice; staff ask for county and type of legal matter and provide a direct referral to a participating attorney.
hours_es: Lunes a viernes, 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m. (hora central), cerrado en días feriados.
hours_en: Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m. Central Time, closed on legal holidays.
verification_notes: Confirmed via official texasbar.com/lris page: phone, hours, cost ($20 consult cap), Spanish-language availability, and statewide coverage with exceptions. Phone-only statewide referral service, so no address used.

title_es: Refugio y apoyo para sobrevivientes de violencia
title_en: Shelter and support for survivors of violence
summary_es: Línea de crisis las 24 horas y refugio de emergencia confidencial y gratuito para sobrevivientes de violencia doméstica, agresión sexual, acoso y trata de personas en el área de Bastrop.
summary_en: A 24-hour crisis hotline and free, confidential emergency shelter for survivors of domestic violence, sexual assault, stalking, and trafficking in the Bastrop area.
description_es: Family Crisis Center (también conocido como Bastrop County Women's Shelter) ofrece refugio de emergencia, planificación de seguridad, defensoría, acompañamiento médico y legal, consejería individual y grupos de apoyo para sobrevivientes de violencia doméstica, violencia en el noviazgo, agresión sexual, acoso (stalking) y trata de personas. La ubicación del refugio es confidencial por seguridad; el acceso es a través de la línea de crisis las 24 horas. La oficina administrativa atiende de lunes a viernes.
description_en: Family Crisis Center (also known as the Bastrop County Women's Shelter) provides emergency shelter, safety planning, advocacy, medical and legal accompaniment, individual counseling, and support groups for survivors of domestic violence, dating violence, sexual assault, stalking, and human trafficking. The shelter's location is kept confidential for safety; access is through the 24-hour crisis hotline. The administrative office is open Monday–Friday.
eligibility_es: Sobrevivientes de violencia doméstica, violencia en el noviazgo, agresión sexual, acoso o trata de personas; el sitio indica que se atiende sin importar edad, ingreso, identidad de género, orientación sexual, raza, etnia, discapacidad, religión, idioma o cultura.
eligibility_en: Survivors of domestic violence, dating violence, sexual assault, stalking, or human trafficking; the organization states it serves people regardless of age, income, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disability, religion, language, or culture.
application_steps_es: Llamar a la línea de crisis las 24 horas para acceder a refugio de emergencia o servicios de defensoría.
application_steps_en: Call the 24-hour crisis hotline to access emergency shelter or advocacy services.
hours_es: Línea de crisis: 24 horas / 7 días. Oficina administrativa: lunes a viernes, 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
hours_en: Crisis hotline: 24/7. Administrative office: Monday–Friday, 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
service_area_es: Condado de Bastrop, Condado de Colorado, Condado de Fayette, Condado de Lee
service_area_en: Bastrop County, Colorado County, Fayette County, Lee County
verification_notes: Confirmed via official site and findhelp.org listing that the emergency shelter address is confidential for safety (standard for DV shelters); therefore address fields left blank even though a public administrative office address (431 Old Austin Hwy, Bastrop, TX 78602) exists — that address is for administrative/counseling services, not the confidential shelter itself, so it was not used to avoid implying the shelter location is public. 24/7 crisis hotline: 512-303-7755 / 888-311-7755; separate office line 512-321-7760 used as main phone. [location-review: confidential]

title_es: Oficina de Servicios para Veteranos del Condado de Bastrop
summary_es: Oficina del condado que ayuda gratuitamente a veteranos y sus familiares o sobrevivientes a solicitar beneficios federales, estatales y locales para veteranos.
summary_en: County office that provides free assistance to veterans and their families or survivors in applying for federal, state, and local veterans benefits.
description_es: La Oficina de Servicios para Veteranos del Condado de Bastrop, con oficiales acreditados, ofrece asesoría sobre beneficios de veteranos y ayuda con la preparación y seguimiento de reclamaciones ante el Departamento de Asuntos de Veteranos de EE. UU. (VA) y el Estado de Texas. Atiende con cita previa en la oficina principal de Bastrop y también ofrece horario limitado por cita en Elgin y Smithville.
description_en: The Bastrop County Veteran Services Office, staffed by accredited Veteran Service Officers, provides counseling on veterans benefits and helps prepare and follow up on claims with the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) and the State of Texas. Appointments are available at the main Bastrop office, with limited by-appointment hours also offered in Elgin and Smithville.
eligibility_es: Veteranos y sus familiares o sobrevivientes que buscan beneficios federales o estatales.
eligibility_en: Veterans and their family members or survivors seeking federal or state benefits.
application_steps_es: Llamar para programar una cita; se requiere cita en todas las ubicaciones.
application_steps_en: Call to schedule an appointment; an appointment is required at all locations.
hours_es: Oficina principal de Bastrop: lunes a jueves, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. (con cita); horario adicional por cita en la Anexa de Elgin los jueves de 1:30 p.m. a 3:00 p.m., y en el Ayuntamiento de Smithville los miércoles de 1:30 p.m. a 3:00 p.m.
hours_en: Main Bastrop office: Monday–Thursday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. (by appointment); additional by-appointment hours at the Elgin Annex on Thursdays 1:30–3:00 p.m., and at Smithville City Hall on Wednesdays 1:30–3:00 p.m.
verification_notes: Confirmed via official Bastrop County government page. Cost confirmed free based on general Texas law/practice that County Veteran Service Officers charge no fee (per TexVet and multiple county VSO pages); not explicitly stated on the Bastrop page itself. Minor address discrepancy across sources: county page lists office at 104 Loop 150, Bastrop, TX 78602 (used here) while also listing a general county veterans-service mailing address of 804 Pecan Street; used the specific office address for walk-in appointments.

organization_name: Red, White & Blue Veterans of Bastrop County
title_es: Apoyo a organizaciones que sirven a veteranos
summary_es: Organización comunitaria sin fines de lucro que apoya a veteranos y organizaciones de veteranos del Condado de Bastrop mediante donaciones y un banquete anual de reconocimiento.
summary_en: A community nonprofit that supports veterans and veteran-serving organizations in Bastrop County through donations and an annual appreciation banquet.
description_es: Red, White & Blue Veterans of Bastrop County es una organización 501(c)(3) formada por veteranos y voluntarios del condado. Su misión es apoyar a organizaciones locales de veteranos que lo necesiten, entregando donaciones a grupos como el Cuerpo de Oficiales de Servicio a Veteranos del condado, los programas NJROTC de las escuelas de Bastrop y Elgin, la Guardia de Honor de Veteranos del Condado de Bastrop y otros. Organizan un banquete anual de agradecimiento a veteranos cerca del Día de los Veteranos.
description_en: Red, White & Blue Veterans of Bastrop County is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit made up of local veterans and volunteers. Its mission is to support local veteran-serving organizations in need, making donations to groups such as the county Veterans Service Office, the Bastrop and Elgin High School NJROTC programs, the Bastrop County Veterans Honor Guard, and others. The group organizes an annual Veterans Appreciation Banquet held near Veterans Day.
eligibility_es: No se especifica un programa de asistencia directa a individuos; la organización dona a otras entidades de veteranos del condado.
eligibility_en: No direct individual-assistance program is specified; the organization donates funds to other county veteran-serving entities.
hours_es: Reuniones mensuales (mar–nov); banquete anual en noviembre
hours_en: Monthly meetings from March through November; annual banquet in November.
verification_notes: Confirmed via organization's own site (rwbveterans.com) and Bastrop/Smithville chamber listings. Note: this appears to be a community fundraising/support organization that donates to other veteran organizations and hosts an annual banquet — it does not appear to provide direct case management or individual financial assistance to veterans itself. Flagging for human review to confirm this is the intended type of resource for the directory (vs. idx 30, the county's official Veteran Services Office, which does provide direct benefits counseling to individuals). A second phone number (330-418-9164) was also found; kept the primary 512 number as it matches the local area.

title_es: Servicios de Cuidado Infantil — Workforce Solutions Rural Capital Area
title_en: Child Care Services — Workforce Solutions Rural Capital Area
summary_es: Ayuda financiera para el cuidado infantil de familias que trabajan, estudian o reciben capacitación en el área de Rural Capital, incluido el Condado de Bastrop.
summary_en: Financial assistance with child care costs for working, in-school, or in-training families in the Rural Capital service area, including Bastrop County.
description_es: El programa de Servicios de Cuidado Infantil de Workforce Solutions Rural Capital Area ayuda a pagar el cuidado infantil para que los padres puedan trabajar, asistir a la escuela o completar capacitación laboral. Las familias deben cumplir con límites de ingreso según el tamaño del hogar y con requisitos mínimos de horas de actividad (empleo, escuela o capacitación). El copago de los padres varía según los ingresos. La solicitud se hace por medio del Portal de Conexión de Cuidado Infantil de Texas o visitando una oficina de Workforce Solutions.
description_en: Workforce Solutions Rural Capital Area's Child Care Services program helps pay for child care so parents can work, attend school, or complete job training. Families must meet income guidelines based on household size and minimum work/education/training hour requirements (25 hrs/week for single-parent households, 50 combined hrs/week for two-parent households). The parent share of cost varies by income. Families apply through the Texas Child Care Connection portal or at a Workforce Solutions office.
eligibility_es: Familias que residen en los condados de Bastrop, Blanco, Burnet, Caldwell, Fayette, Hays, Lee, Llano o Williamson; el niño debe ser ciudadano estadounidense o inmigrante legal; los padres deben cumplir un mínimo de horas semanales de trabajo, escuela o capacitación (25 horas para un padre soltero, 50 horas combinadas para dos padres); y la familia debe cumplir con los límites de ingreso vigentes.
eligibility_en: Households residing in Bastrop, Blanco, Burnet, Caldwell, Fayette, Hays, Lee, Llano, or Williamson counties; the child must be a U.S. citizen or legal immigrant; parents must meet minimum weekly hours of work/school/training (25 hrs for single-parent households, 50 combined hrs for two-parent households); and the family must meet current income guidelines.
application_steps_es: Completar una solicitud de lista de espera en el Portal de Conexión de Cuidado Infantil de Texas (childcare.twc.texas.gov/find/welcome), por teléfono, por correo electrónico solicitando una solicitud en papel, o en persona en una oficina de Workforce Solutions Rural Capital Area.
application_steps_en: Complete a waitlist application through the Texas Child Care Connection portal (childcare.twc.texas.gov/find/welcome), by phone, by email requesting a paper application, or in person at a Workforce Solutions Rural Capital Area office.
service_area_es: Condado de Williamson, Condado de Bastrop, Condado de Hays, Condado de Caldwell, Condado de Blanco, Condado de Burnet
service_area_en: Williamson County, Bastrop County, Hays County, Caldwell County, Blanco County, Burnet County
verification_notes: Confirmed via official WSRCA site (workforcesolutionsrca.com/childcare/parents): eligibility, income-guideline PDF, application process, phone, email. This is a regional benefit program applied for online/by phone; no single service address applies, so address fields left blank. Related to idx 38 (WSRCA Bastrop Office) — same parent organization; that record covers the physical Bastrop office rather than this specific child-care subsidy program. Flagging both for review to confirm they should remain as separate directory entries. [location-review: variable]

organization_name: Ciudad de Elgin, Parques y Recreación
title_es: Actividades para Adultos Mayores de Elgin
summary_es: El Departamento de Parques y Recreación de Elgin ofrece actividades gratuitas para adultos mayores (55+) en el Centro Recreativo de Elgin, incluyendo café social, caminatas, bingo y manualidades.
summary_en: The City of Elgin Parks and Recreation Department offers free activities for older adults (55+) at the Elgin Recreation Center, including a coffee social, walking groups, bingo, and crafts.
description_es: El Centro Recreativo de Elgin ofrece programación semanal para adultos mayores bajo el nombre 'Prime Timer', incluyendo un Club Social de Café (lunes a sábado), grupos de caminata (Wildcat Walkers y Extreme Walking), y actividades rotativas los lunes por la tarde: clase de habilidades dirigida por adultos mayores, día de bingo, día de manualidades y excursiones, cada una en una semana distinta del mes. Las actividades son gratuitas, con suministros limitados.
description_en: The Elgin Recreation Center offers weekly 'Prime Timer' programming for older adults, including a Senior Coffee Social Club (Monday–Saturday), walking groups (Wildcat Walkers and Extreme Walking), and rotating Monday-afternoon activities: a senior-led skills class, bingo day, craft day, and field trips, each on a different week of the month. Activities are free, with limited supplies available.
eligibility_es: Adultos de 55 años o más para la programación 'Prime Timer'; algunas actividades como el café social están abiertas a adultos mayores en general.
eligibility_en: Adults age 55 and older for 'Prime Timer' programming; some activities like the coffee social are open to older adults generally.
application_steps_es: Registrarse con el personal de recepción del Centro Recreativo de Elgin o en línea en secure.rec1.com.
application_steps_en: Register with Elgin Recreation Center front desk staff or online at secure.rec1.com.
hours_es: Club Social de Café: lunes a sábado, 8:00–11:00 a.m.; Wildcat Walkers: lunes a sábado, 8:00–10:00 a.m.; Extreme Walking: martes y jueves, 8:00–10:00 a.m.; actividades Prime Timer: lunes, 2:00–4:00 p.m.
hours_en: Senior Coffee Social Club: Monday–Saturday, 8:00–11:00 a.m.; Wildcat Walkers: Monday–Saturday, 8:00–10:00 a.m.; Extreme Walking: Tuesday & Thursday, 8:00–10:00 a.m.; Prime Timer Activities: Monday, 2:00–4:00 p.m.
verification_notes: Confirmed program schedule, cost, and registration process via the official City of Elgin Senior Activities page, and confirmed the Elgin Recreation Center's street address (361 N. Hwy 95) and phone (512-285-6434) via the official Recreation Center page, both fetched today. organization_name: Ladies of Charity of Bastrop / Ascension Catholic Church
title_es: Asistencia con facturas de servicios públicos
summary_es: Programa de asistencia benévola de la Iglesia Ascension en Bastrop que ayuda a residentes de Bastrop, Cedar Creek y Paige con el pago de servicios públicos.
summary_en: Benevolent assistance program of Ascension Catholic Church in Bastrop that helps residents of Bastrop, Cedar Creek, and Paige with utility bill payments.
description_es: A través de su Fondo Benevolente, la Iglesia Ascension en Bastrop ofrece ayuda para pagar servicios públicos (electricidad, agua y gas) a residentes de las ciudades de Bastrop, Cedar Creek o Paige, hasta $125 por solicitud, con un límite de una vez cada seis meses. Para solicitar, la persona debe presentarse en persona en la recepción de la oficina administrativa de la iglesia y completar el Formulario de Solicitud Benevolente.
description_en: Through its Benevolent Fund, Ascension Catholic Church in Bastrop offers help paying utility bills (electric, water, and gas) to residents of the cities of Bastrop, Cedar Creek, or Paige, up to $125 per request, limited to once every six months. To apply, a person must go in person to the front desk of the church's administrative office and complete a Benevolent Request Form.
eligibility_es: Residentes de las ciudades de Bastrop, Cedar Creek o Paige; el beneficio puede recibirse una vez cada 6 meses, hasta $125.
eligibility_en: Residents of the cities of Bastrop, Cedar Creek, or Paige; benefit available once every 6 months, up to $125.
required_documents_es: Formulario de Solicitud Benevolente (Benevolent Request Form), completado en persona.
required_documents_en: Benevolent Request Form, completed in person.
application_steps_es: Presentarse en persona en la recepción de la oficina administrativa de la iglesia durante el horario de atención y solicitar el Formulario de Solicitud Benevolente.
application_steps_en: Go in person to the front desk of the church administrative office during business hours and ask to complete the Benevolent Request Form.
hours_es: Lunes a viernes, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. (cerrado de 12:00 a 1:00 p.m. para el almuerzo).
hours_en: Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. (closed for lunch 12:00–1:00 p.m.).
verification_notes: The church's own Ladies of Charity page (ascensionbastrop.com/locbastrop) and the findhelp.org listing both returned 403 Forbidden when fetched directly today, so this could not be verified from a live page today; details (benefit amount/frequency, cities served, application process) come from a search-engine AI summary of the findhelp.org listing and should be re-confirmed with the church. Church address/phone/hours were separately confirmed via directory listings (Yelp, local business directories). An older nonprofit database entry (Candid.org) lists a separate contact 'Agnes Raz, 512-321-9819' and a slightly different address (1202 Pine St) — this may be outdated or a related-but-distinct listing; used the church's main current number and address instead. Note: 1201 Pine St in this same batch's research also came up for the unrelated Bastrop County Emergency Food Pantry — addresses are close but distinct, not the same organization.

title_es: Tienda de Segunda Mano y Apoyo Comunitario
summary_es: Tienda de segunda mano dirigida por una alianza de iglesias de Smithville que vende ropa y artículos usados a bajo costo y reinvierte las ganancias en organizaciones locales.
summary_en: Thrift store run by a coalition of Smithville churches selling low-cost secondhand clothing and goods, with proceeds reinvested in local nonprofits.
description_es: Born Again Emporium (BAE) es una tienda de segunda mano totalmente voluntaria, sin fines de lucro, creada en 2014 como un esfuerzo conjunto de congregaciones cristianas de Smithville a través de su Alianza Ministerial. Vende ropa, artículos para el hogar y otros bienes donados, y también recibe donaciones de artículos durante su horario de atención. Las ganancias se reinvierten en la comunidad a través de subvenciones a organizaciones sin fines de lucro locales.
description_en: Born Again Emporium (BAE) is an all-volunteer, nonprofit thrift store started in 2014 as a joint effort of Smithville Christian congregations through their Ministerial Alliance. It sells clothing, household items, and other donated goods, and also accepts item donations during store hours. Proceeds are reinvested in the community through grants to local nonprofits.
eligibility_es: Abierto al público en general; no se mencionan restricciones de elegibilidad para comprar.
eligibility_en: Open to the general public; no eligibility restrictions mentioned for shopping.
application_steps_es: Visitar la tienda durante su horario de atención para comprar o donar artículos.
application_steps_en: Visit the store during operating hours to shop or donate items.
hours_es: Viernes y sábado, 9:00 a.m.–2:00 p.m.
hours_en: Friday and Saturday, 9:00 a.m.–2:00 p.m.
verification_notes:
Confirmed address, phone, and hours via the official site today. This is a low-cost thrift store (goods are sold, not given away free), so cost_type is 'paid' even though the organization also gives grants to other nonprofits.
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX

title_es: Conexión con Servicios de Salud y Apoyo Comunitario
summary_es: Organización de impacto colectivo que conecta a residentes del Condado de Bastrop con navegación de servicios de salud y sociales, transporte a citas médicas y ayuda para inscribirse en beneficios.
summary_en: Collective-impact nonprofit that connects Bastrop County residents to health and social service navigation, transportation to medical appointments, and help enrolling in benefits.
description_es: Bastrop County Cares funciona como organización 'backbone' que une a socios públicos, privados y confesionales del Condado de Bastrop. Ofrece CARE Rides (transporte a citas médicas para personas mayores elegibles y mujeres embarazadas), trabajadores de salud comunitarios que ayudan a navegar servicios de salud y sociales, apoyo de doulas, e inscripción gratuita en beneficios (SNAP, TANF, Medicaid, CHIP, WIC) en alianza con Foundation Communities el tercer miércoles de cada mes. También ofrece talleres educativos y actividades comunitarias.
description_en: Bastrop County Cares acts as a 'backbone' organization uniting public, private, and faith-based partners across Bastrop County. It offers CARE Rides (transportation to medical appointments for eligible seniors and expecting mothers), community health workers who help residents navigate health and social services, doula support, and free benefits enrollment help (SNAP, TANF, Medicaid, CHIP, WIC) in partnership with Foundation Communities on the third Wednesday of each month. It also runs educational workshops and community activities.
eligibility_es: Residentes del Condado de Bastrop; CARE Rides es para personas mayores elegibles y mujeres embarazadas; otros programas pueden tener requisitos propios.
eligibility_en: Bastrop County residents; CARE Rides is for eligible seniors and expecting mothers; other programs may have their own requirements.
application_steps_es: Llamar al 512-409-3116 para navegación de servicios o CARE Rides, o consultar el sitio web para programas específicos como la inscripción de beneficios (tercer miércoles del mes).
application_steps_en: Call 512-409-3116 for service navigation or CARE Rides, or check the website for specific programs like benefits enrollment (third Wednesday of the month).
hours_es: Línea de llamadas L–V 9am–4pm
hours_en: Call line Mon–Fri (9 am–4 pm)
verification_notes:
Verified directly by Puente ATX: Bastrop County Cares is a separate organization from the Bastrop County Emergency Food Pantry (bastropfoodpantry.org); they are different nonprofits and should not be treated as duplicates. The organization’s official website lists its office at 806 Water St., Bastrop, TX 78602. However, this is an administrative office and should not be assumed to be a walk-in location for all services, which may be provided through community health workers, partner organizations, and off-site events. The website provides Spanish-language content through an “Español” option, but live Spanish-language phone navigation was not independently confirmed.
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX.

title_es: Despensa de Alimentos y Apoyo para Familias
summary_es: Despensa de alimentos y centro de recursos en Pflugerville que sirve a miles de familias al mes, con distribución tipo drive-thru y un programa de apoyo a familias sin hogar.
summary_en: Food pantry and resource center in Pflugerville serving thousands of families each month, with drive-thru distribution and a program supporting families experiencing homelessness.
description_es: Circle of Hope Community Center opera una despensa de alimentos tipo drive-thru (pan, frutas y verduras frescas, carnes congeladas, lácteos y alimentos no perecederos) y una despensa móvil en alianza con el Banco de Alimentos de Central Texas. Su Centro de Recursos y Aprendizaje conecta a la comunidad con recursos de salud, vivienda para adultos mayores y servicios humanos. El programa Project Hope apoya a familias sin hogar en transición hacia vivienda permanente con útiles escolares, ropa y muebles.
description_en: Circle of Hope Community Center operates a drive-thru food pantry (bread, fresh produce, frozen meats, dairy, and non-perishable food) and a mobile pantry in partnership with the Central Texas Food Bank. Its Resource & Learning Center connects the community to health, senior housing, and human services resources. Its Project Hope program supports homeless families transitioning to permanent housing with school supplies, clothing, and furniture.
eligibility_es: Abierto a la comunidad de Pflugerville y áreas circundantes; consulte la política de servicio del centro para reglas específicas de elegibilidad.
eligibility_en: Open to the Pflugerville community and surrounding areas; see the center's serving policy for specific eligibility rules.
application_steps_es: Visitar el centro durante las horas de distribución, ingresando por el estacionamiento en Three Points Road; los visitantes nuevos pueden consultar la información de orientación en el sitio web.
application_steps_en: Visit the center during distribution hours, entering through the parking lot on Three Points Road; first-time visitors can review orientation information on the website.
hours_es: Despensa (drive-thru): lunes y viernes, 8:00–11:00 a.m.; despensa móvil: primer martes del mes, 9:00–11:00 a.m.
hours_en: Food pantry (drive-thru): Monday and Friday, 8:00–11:00 a.m.; mobile pantry: first Tuesday of the month, 9:00–11:00 a.m.
accessibility_notes_es: Drive-thru para la distribución de alimentos. Los nuevos clientes deben registrarse primero y recibir una tarjeta de cliente antes de acudir los lunes o viernes.
accessibility_notes_en: Drive-thru food distribution. New clients must first register and receive a client card before coming on Mondays or Fridays.
verification_notes:
Spanish and Vietnamese support available through translators.
La organización menciona específicamente Pflugerville, Round Rock, Hutto, Austin, Georgetown, Taylor, Cedar Park y Leander.
The information was confirmed through the official Circle of Hope Community Center website. The food pantry offers drive-thru distribution on Mondays and Fridays from 8:00–11:00 AM and currently reports serving more than 2,500 families and over 10,000 individuals each month. Project Hope provides additional support to low-income families and families transitioning from homelessness to permanent housing. New clients must register before receiving food. The organization also provides access to Spanish and Vietnamese interpreters.
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX.

organization_name: Travis County Health and Human Services
title_es: Centro Comunitario del Condado de Travis — Pflugerville
summary_es: Centro comunitario del Condado de Travis en Pflugerville que ofrece despensa de alimentos, asistencia con servicios públicos, ropero, comidas para adultos mayores y ayuda con empleo y trabajo social.
summary_en: Travis County community center in Pflugerville offering a food pantry, utility assistance, a clothing closet, senior meals, and job search and social work help.
description_es: El Centro Comunitario de Pflugerville, operado por Travis County Health and Human Services, ofrece despensa de alimentos (se recomienda cita, cerrada los martes de 8am a 1pm para reabastecimiento), servicios de WIC, programa de almuerzo para adultos mayores de 60+ (lunes, miércoles y viernes), asistencia con servicios públicos y vivienda, búsqueda de empleo con computadoras públicas, ropero de ropa usada gratuita, y trabajo social.
description_en: The Pflugerville Community Center, operated by Travis County Health and Human Services, offers a food pantry (appointment recommended, closed Tuesdays 8am-1pm for restocking), co-located WIC services, a senior lunch program for ages 60+ (Monday, Wednesday, Friday), utility and housing-related financial assistance, job search help with public computers, a free used-clothing closet, and social work services.
eligibility_es: Servicios gratuitos para residentes del Condado de Travis; el programa de almuerzo para adultos mayores es gratuito para cualquier persona de 60 años o más; el ropero tiene límite de una vez cada 30 días.
eligibility_en: Free services for Travis County residents; the senior lunch program is free for anyone age 60 or older; the clothing closet is limited to once every 30 days.
application_steps_es: Se aceptan personas sin cita, pero se recomienda llamar al (512) 854-1530 para agendar cita, especialmente para la despensa de alimentos.
application_steps_en: Walk-ins are welcome, but calling (512) 854-1530 to schedule an appointment is encouraged, especially for the food pantry.
hours_es: Lunes a viernes, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. (despensa cerrada los martes de 8am a 1pm para reabastecimiento); comidas de adultos mayores lunes, miércoles y viernes.
hours_en: Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. (food pantry closed Tuesdays 8am-1pm for restocking); senior meals Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.
accessibility_notes_es: En persona y mediante solicitud para los servicios que requieren elegibilidad. Para la despensa, se recomienda llamar al 512-854-1530 para programar una cita, aunque también aceptan personas sin cita.
accessibility_notes_en: In person and by application for services requiring eligibility. For the food pantry, it is recommended to call 512-854-1530 to schedule an appointment, although walk-ins are also accepted.
verification_notes:
Spanish not confirmed
Some programs have eligibility requirements.
The information was confirmed through the official Travis County Health & Human Services pages. The Pflugerville Community Center is a separate location from the Manor, Del Valle, and Jonestown community centers, with its own address and phone number. Services include a food pantry, utility assistance, clothing, senior meals, job search support, and social work/case management. Spanish-language services were not officially confirmed.
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX

title_es: Atención Médica, Dental y Salud Mental para Familias
title_en: Medical, Dental & Mental Health Care for Families
summary_es: Clínica de salud familiar, pediátrica y dental con tarifas según ingreso.
summary_en: Family, pediatric, and dental health clinic with income-based fees.
description_es: Medicina familiar e interna, pediatría, salud de la mujer, consejería de salud conductual, y odontología para adultos y niños. Escala móvil de pago según ingresos; asistencia financiera disponible.
description_en: Family and internal medicine, pediatrics, women's health, behavioral health counseling, and dental care for adults and children. Sliding-scale fees based on income; financial assistance available.
eligibility_es: CommUnityCare ofrece atención independientemente del seguro médico o la capacidad de pago. Los pacientes pueden calificar para asistencia financiera según sus ingresos y tamaño del hogar. Se aceptan Medicaid, Medicare, CHIP, MAP y muchos seguros privados, dependiendo del servicio.
eligibility_en: CommUnityCare provides care regardless of insurance status or ability to pay. Patients may qualify for financial assistance based on income and household size. Medicaid, Medicare, CHIP, MAP and many private insurance plans are accepted, depending on the service.
hours_es:
Clínica médica: lunes–jueves 7:00 AM–7:00 PM; viernes 7:00 AM–5:00 PM; sábado 8:00 AM–12:00 PM. 
Dental para adultos: lunes–jueves 7:30 AM–6:00 PM. 
Dental pediátrico: martes–jueves 7:30 AM–6:00 PM. Laboratorio: lunes–viernes 7:30 AM–4:00 PM, cerrado de 12:30–2:00 PM.
hours_en:
Medical clinic: Monday–Thursday 7:00 AM–7:00 PM; Friday 7:00 AM–5:00 PM; Saturday 8:00 AM–12:00 PM. 
Adult dental: Monday–Thursday 7:30 AM–6:00 PM. 
Pediatric dental: Tuesday–Thursday 7:30 AM–6:00 PM. 
Lab: Monday–Friday 7:30 AM–4:00 PM, closed 12:30–2:00 PM.
accessibility_notes_es: Llame al número correspondiente para programar una cita. Atención médica: 512-978-9840; dental: 512-359-9404. Los nuevos pacientes también pueden programar por MyChart o llamar al 512-978-9015 para recibir ayuda. Hay servicios de evaluación de elegibilidad financiera.
accessibility_notes_en: Call the appropriate clinic number to schedule an appointment. Medical appointments: 512-978-9840; dental: 512-359-9404. New patients can also schedule through MyChart or call 512-978-9015 for assistance. Financial eligibility screening is available.
service_area_es: Pflugerville y comunidades cercanas del área de Austin/Central Texas. La clínica está ubicada en Travis County, cerca del límite con Williamson County
service_area_en: Pflugerville and surrounding communities in the Austin/Central Texas area. The clinic is located in Travis County near the Williamson County border.
verification_notes:
Phone: Medical: 512-978-9840 • Dental: 512-359-9404 • Patient Navigation Center: 512-978-9015.

Services: CommUnityCare's services are not restricted exclusively to residents of one city.

Cost: Costs vary by service and insurance. Eligible patients may receive discounted fees through the Sliding Fee Scale based on income and household size. CommUnityCare is not necessarily free, but financial assistance is available.

Dental services include exams, cleanings, fillings, extractions, dentures, sealants and emergency treatment; orthodontics, implants, crowns and bridges are not provided. Uninsured patients may qualify for dental services based on income guidelines.
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX.

organization_name: Pflugerville Independent School District (PfISD) – Social Work
title_es: Conexión con Recursos Comunitarios para Familias
summary_es: El equipo de Trabajo Social de Pflugerville ISD conecta a estudiantes y familias con despensas de alimentos y otros recursos comunitarios para necesidades básicas.
summary_en: Pflugerville ISD’s Social Work team connects students and families with local food pantries and other community resources for basic needs.
description_es: El equipo de Trabajo Social de PfISD ayuda a estudiantes y familias a identificar y acceder a recursos comunitarios. El distrito mantiene información actualizada sobre despensas de alimentos locales y otros servicios de apoyo, y sus trabajadores sociales pueden realizar referencias según las necesidades de cada familia.
description_en: PfISD’s Social Work team helps students and families identify and access community resources. The district maintains information on local food assistance and other support services, and school social workers can make referrals based on each family’s needs.
eligibility_es: Familias con estudiantes inscritos en Pflugerville ISD.
eligibility_en: Families with students enrolled in Pflugerville ISD.
application_steps_es: Comunicarse con el trabajador social de la escuela de su hijo/a o consultar la página de Asistencia Alimentaria Local del distrito para ver la lista de despensas y recursos.
application_steps_en: Contact your child's school social worker or review the district's Local Food Assistance page for a list of pantries and resources.
hours_es: Lunes–viernes, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM para el área de Counseling/Social Work; el contacto puede variar según el campus
hours_en: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM for Counseling/Social Work; contact details may vary by campus.
accessibility_notes_es: Las familias pueden comunicarse con el trabajador social de su campus o con el área de Social Work para recibir orientación y referencias a recursos comunitarios.
accessibility_notes_en: Families can contact their campus social worker or the Social Work department for guidance and referrals to community resources.
verification_notes:
English; Spanish resources available. Spanish-speaking staff not confirmed.
Free / Gratis — referral and resource-navigation support. Individual community services may have their own eligibility or costs.
Verified directly by Puente ATX: The official PfISD page returned primarily navigation elements when accessed today, so specific eligibility, cost, and service details could not be independently confirmed from the page content. The phone number listed is the district’s general main line (512-594-0000), not a direct Social Work Department number. No single walk-in address was identified for this resource-coordination service, so the address field should be left blank. The program lists Circle of Hope Community Center (idx 22) as one of its referral resources; Circle of Hope is a separate, standalone resource in this batch and is not a duplicate.

title_es: Asistencia para la Búsqueda de Empleo
summary_es: La Biblioteca Pública de Pflugerville ofrece recursos de empleo, incluyendo asistencia en persona para la búsqueda de trabajo y acceso a la plataforma en línea BlueCareer para oficios especializados.
summary_en: Pflugerville Public Library offers employment resources, including in-person job search assistance and access to the BlueCareer online platform for skilled trades.
description_es: La Biblioteca Pública de Pflugerville ofrece una sección dedicada a personas que buscan empleo, con recursos para apoyar la búsqueda de trabajo y el desarrollo profesional. También ofrece computadoras, Wi-Fi y recursos electrónicos que pueden utilizarse para buscar empleos, preparar solicitudes y acceder a información profesional.
description_en: The Pflugerville Public Library offers dedicated resources for job seekers, including support for job searching and career development. The library also provides computers, Wi-Fi, and electronic resources that can be used to search for jobs, complete applications, and access career information.
eligibility_es: Abierto al público; puede requerirse tarjeta de la biblioteca para algunos recursos en línea.
eligibility_en: Open to the public; a library card may be needed for some online resources.
application_steps_es: Visitar la biblioteca durante la asistencia en persona (segundo y cuarto sábado, 11am-1pm) o acceder a BlueCareer a través del catálogo de la biblioteca en línea.
application_steps_en: Visit the library during in-person assistance hours (second and fourth Saturday, 11 a.m.–1 p.m.) or access BlueCareer through the library's online catalog.
hours_es: Asistencia en persona: segundo y cuarto sábado del mes, 11:00 a.m.–1:00 p.m.; recursos en línea disponibles según el horario de la biblioteca.
hours_en: In-person assistance: second and fourth Saturday of the month, 11:00 a.m.–1:00 p.m.; online resources available during library hours.
accessibility_notes_es: En persona en la biblioteca y mediante recursos en línea.
accessibility_notes_en: In person at the library and through online resources.
verification_notes:
Spanish not confirmed
La página oficial de Pflugerville Public Library confirma una sección específica de Assistance for Job Seekers y recursos relacionados con empleo. La biblioteca también ofrece computadoras, Wi-Fi y recursos electrónicos. El servicio en español no está confirmado oficialmente y no debe asumirse.

organization_name: Pflugerville Parks & Recreation —  City of Pflugerville
title_es: Programas para Adultos Mayores
summary_es: Programas recreativos y sociales para adultos mayores de 55 años en Pflugerville, con actividades, eventos y oportunidades para conectar con la comunidad.
summary_en: Recreational and social programs for adults 55 and older in Pflugerville, offering activities, events, and opportunities to connect with the community.
description_es: El Departamento de Parques y Recreación de Pflugerville ofrece programación para adultos mayores (55+) en el Centro Recreativo de Pflugerville, incluyendo clases, ayuda tecnológica, eventos y actividades sociales. description_en: Pflugerville Parks & Recreation offers programming for adults 55 and older at the Pflugerville Recreation Center, including classes, tech help, events, and social activities. Membership is required to participate; per one source, fees were $3 (resident) / $10 (non-resident) individual and $5 (resident) / $15 (non-resident) couple, but this could not be confirmed on the current official page.
eligibility_es: Adultos de 55 años o más; se requiere membresía para participar en los programas.
eligibility_en: Adults age 55 and older; membership required to participate in programs.
application_steps_es: Inscribirse como miembro en el Centro Recreativo de Pflugerville y pagar la cuota correspondiente (residente o no residente).
application_steps_en: Register as a member at the Pflugerville Recreation Center and pay the applicable fee (resident or non-resident).
hours_es: Varía por programa
hours_en: Varies by program.
verification_notes:
Spanish not confirmed.
